jobs.title: Senior Professional Services Project Manager, Paris
Senior Product Designer - Berlin
jobs.description:
About RA

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

Resident Advisor helps users explore the world of electronic music, from finding their next night out and buying tickets to discovering the artists, clubs and scenes behind it.

The mandate

We're looking for a senior product designer to join our design team and set the design direction for our consumer products: ra.co and the RA Guide app, used by millions of ticket buyers, readers and electronic music fans annually. The role also encompasses RA PRO, our B2B offering for promoters listing events and tickets on RA.

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data, Commercial and Growth teams to design experiences that help users stay engaged with the electronic music community via RA while contributing to the future development of the platform.

This is a senior role for a designer who combines strong product thinking and exceptional craft with hands-on experience of AI-assisted design. You'll lead projects from discovery through delivery, set the standard for design quality across the team, and own the evolution of the RA Design System so it works as well for AI tools and agents as it does for designers and engineers.

Responsibilities

Product design and leadership

  • Lead design for Resident Advisor's consumer products end to end, across web and native app touchpoints.
  • Set design direction and quality standards, and partner with Product, Engineering and Data leads to shape strategy, roadmaps and prioritisation.
  • Mentor and coach other designers through critique, pairing and feedback, raising the bar for craft across the team.
  • Lead discovery activities including user research, workshops and analysis of customer feedback and data.
  • Work closely with engineers throughout implementation to ensure quality execution and close the gap between design and code.

Design systems and AI

  • Own the RA Design System: maintain, evolve and govern tokens, components and patterns so they stay consistent across Figma and code.
  • Structure and document the design system so developers and AI can use it reliably and efficiently.
  • Bring AI into the design workflow, using it for research synthesis, ideation, prototyping and production, and helping the wider team adopt it thoughtfully.
  • Document design decisions, patterns and best practices in a way both people and AI tools can use.

Who we are looking for

  • A portfolio demonstrating strong product design thinking, visual craft and impact on products shipped at scale.
  • 4+ years of Product Design experience, including time in a senior or lead role setting design direction for a product area.
  • Experience mentoring designers and influencing product and engineering stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience using AI in your design practice, from ideation and prototyping to working with AI coding tools, and a considered point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't.
  • Deep experience building and maintaining design systems, including design tokens, component libraries and documentation, and keeping Figma and code in sync.
  • An understanding of what makes a design system usable by AI: structured tokens, consistent naming, well-defined component properties and clear usage guidance.
  • Expert UI and interaction design skills with a keen eye for detail.
  • A strong grasp of user-centred design and balancing user and business needs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and experience working in Agile product teams.
  • Experience designing AI-powered or personalised product experiences is a plus.

What we offer you

  • Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance.
  • Flexibility in working arrangements, offering hybrid or remote work options based on role requirements and location.
  • Matching pension schemes and/or 401k.
  • Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs.
  • Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on RA merch.
  • Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about.
  • Regular company-wide Q&As with senior leadership, along with ongoing virtual educational training sessions for all staff.
  • A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity).
  • Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community).

More about RA

We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis.

Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it.

RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge.

We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

Our values

  • Electronic music is art.
  • We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music.
  • We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community.
  • We honour the past, present and future of electronic music.
  • We use innovation to empower the community.
  • We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit.
  • We're always front left.

This role is a permanent position based in Berlin. Please note: This position requires applicants to be based in Berlin and to work from the office three days per week. The annual salary for this role is €50k–€60k. If you have questions about the role, please contact

jobs.title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
jobs.description:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

Deep in the wording. Fast in the build.

About Insify

Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who you are

You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

  • You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.
  • You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
  • You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
  • You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.
  • You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.
  • You think like the customer: plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.
  • You’re at home in Excel and data, and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.
  • You work fluently in English; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

    • What we offer
  • Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.
  • Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.
  • A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.
  • A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.
  • Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.
  • The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).
  • The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analist / Product Owner E-health
jobs.description:
Met je hoofd in de ICT, je hart bij de zorg en oog voor de mogelijkheden van AI.

Over PharmaPartners en eHealth

PharmaPartners ontwikkelt en beheert zorgsystemen voor de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg. Wij zijn een organisatie met een uitgesproken visie én aanpak op continue vernieuwing met de focus op groei. Daar kan jij een bijdrage aan leveren.

De business unit eHealth levert vernieuwende producten aan huisartsen en apotheken ter ondersteuning van hun patiënten. Met ons online portaal en onze app kunnen patiënten communiceren met hun huisarts en apotheek en onder andere hun medisch dossier inzien. Ruim 8 miljoen patiënten maken gebruik van ons portaal. Daarmee zijn we een van de grootste spelers op het gebied van e-health in de Nederlandse eerstelijnszorg.


Binnen Research & Development zetten we volop in op AI en agentic development. AI wordt steeds meer onderdeel van de manier waarop we analyseren, ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, testen en documenteren. Als Business Analist / Product Owner speel je hierin een actieve rol: je benut de mogelijkheden van AI, houdt regie op de inhoud en bewaakt samen met het team de kwaliteit, veiligheid en toepasbaarheid van de resultaten.

Jouw rol

Als Senior Business Analist / Product Owner ben je de brug tussen de business, klanten, gebruikers en development, met een leidende rol in de productontwikkeling. Je draagt bij aan de productvisie en roadmap en vertaalt die naar heldere prioriteiten voor de teams. Je begrijpt de behoeften van gebruikers en vertaalt deze naar functionele vereisten, technische specificaties en concrete ontwikkelvoorstellen.

Je werkt in een complexe en veranderende omgeving en houdt overzicht wanneer er veel tegelijk speelt. Je kijkt niet alleen naar wat vandaag nodig is, maar vooral naar wat morgen waarde levert: nieuwe marktontwikkelingen, innovatiekansen en de mogelijkheden van AI. Je neemt eigenaarschap over de volledige levenscyclus van je producten en je coacht collega’s in het vak. Je helpt het team om AI en agentic development verantwoord en effectief in te zetten binnen het ontwikkelproces.


Daarnaast vind jij het leuk om:

  • De behoeften van verschillende belanghebbenden, waaronder onze klanten en gebruikers, in kaart te brengen, documenteren en met elkaar in overeenstemming te brengen;

  • Eén of meer of meerdere scrum teams aan te sturen, die je begeleid in het ontwikkelproces volgens de SCRUM methodiek (planning, retrospective, refinements, e.d.);

  • De kwaliteit van de producten te waarborgen en continu te verbeteren door afstemming met de ontwikkelteams en alle betrokken stakeholders;

  • De schakel te zijn tussen klant en organisatie, waarbij je de klantwensen vertaalt naar concrete voorstellen en deze prioriteert op een product backlog;

  • AI in te zetten ter ondersteuning van bijvoorbeeld analyse, requirements, prototyping, documentatie en voorbereiding van refinements (natuurlijk zorg je ook voor een grondige controle, review en validatie op de output van AI;

  • De kwaliteit van producten bewaken en borgen dat deze voldoen aan de kwaliteits-, product- en informatiebeveiligingsnormen, in afstemming met ontwikkelteams en stakeholders;

  • De product backlog creëren, prioriteren en onderhouden, zodat het developmentteam aan de juiste ontwikkelingen werkt.

Werken met AI en agentic development

AI verandert de manier waarop software wordt ontwikkeld. Binnen PharmaPartners werken R&D-teams toe naar een gedeelde agentic way of working. De mens blijft verantwoordelijk voor keuzes en resultaten, terwijl AI ondersteunt bij onderdelen van het werk. Daarom zoeken we iemand die kansen ziet, kritisch blijft en nieuwe werkwijzen snel eigen maakt.

Heb je al ervaring met AI-tools, AI-agents, skills, prompten of agentic development? Dan is dat een duidelijke pré. Heb je die ervaring nog niet, maar ben je nieuwsgierig, leergierig en bereid je hierin actief onder te dompelen? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je werkt in een enthousiast Portfolio- en R&D-team en rapporteert aan de Teamlead Portfolio. Je levert een zichtbare bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste eHealth-platformen van Nederland en hebt als senior invloed op de koers van het product en de werkwijze van het team. Dat doe je samen met open, eerlijke, en behulpzame collega’s in een hechte en informele organisatie.


Herken jij je hierin?

  • Jij hebt minimaal HBO+ werk- en denkniveau in de richting van bedrijfskunde, IT, zorgtechnologie of iets soortgelijks;

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in de zorg-ICT, in een rol als business analist of product owner;

  • Jouw kennis van de Nederlandse taal zit op minimaal C2-niveau. Ook in het Engels kun jij je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken;

  • Ruime ervaring met business analysetechnieken en het documenteren van requirements, ook bij complexe vraagstukken;

  • Je hebt ervaring met het bijdragen aan productvisie en roadmap en met het prioriteren op basis van strategische doelen;

  • Je vindt het niet erg als jouw werkdag soms anders loopt, of buiten een vast 9 tot 5 patroon valt;

  • Je deelt gemakkelijk kennis (van de Nederlandse zorgmarkt) en informatie met anderen;

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen, ook als de druk op je werk toeneemt en houdt altijd overzicht.

Je bent communicatief vaardig, ambitieus en gedisciplineerd. Je durft vragen te stellen, keuzes te onderbouwen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, en je neemt anderen mee in je koers. Tegelijk werk je graag samen, sta je open voor feedback en heb je de nieuwsgierigheid en het lef om nieuwe technologie verantwoord toe te passen.

Klaar om samen met ons de koers van eHealth en softwareontwikkeling te bepalen?

Dan zoeken we jou!

En is dit wat je zoekt?

  • Een passend salaris: Voor deze vacature geldt een range van € 4.000 - € 5.500 bruto p/m op basis van een fulltime werkweek.

  • €500,- persoonlijk budget: Gebruik het voor een sportabonnement, of investeer in je eigen ontwikkeling.

  • 26 vakantiedagen en 8,33% vakantiegeld: Eventueel kun je zelfs nog 5 extra vakantiedagen erbij kopen (naar rato).

  • Beschikbare pensioenpremie: wij zijn aangesloten bij Allianz en bieden een premie met een eigen bijdrage van 4,8%.

  • Ruimte voor groei: Binnen PharmaPartners bieden wij diverse Talentenprogamma’s aan, die gericht zijn op persoonlijke ontwikkeling, het inzetten van jouw talent en kracht en een programma om erachter te komen of dat jij jezelf in een leidinggevende rol ziet!

  • Een hechte, open werksfeer: Ervaar een warme, open werkomgeving waar collega’s samen successen vieren. Binnen PharmaPartners zorgt de Brabantse gezelligheid voor een laagdrempelige benadering en een sterke teamspirit.

  • Leaseauto : Wij bieden jou een leaseregeling aan zodat jij met goed vervoer jouw klanten kunt bezoeken.

  • Uitdagende functie: Ga de uitdaging aan bij een organisatie die impact maakt in de samenleving in de zorgsector. Je draagt direct bij aan de maatschappij door te werken voor de zorg, waar jouw inzet het verschil maakt.

  • Sporten onder werktijd: Bij PharmaPartners moedigen we een gezonde levensstijl aan, inclusief sporten onder werktijd. Op dinsdag en donderdag heb je de mogelijkheid om samen met collega’s aan het eind van de dag te gaan sporten.

  • Hybride werken: Hybride werken bij ons betekent dat je twee keer per week op kantoor wordt verwacht, terwijl je de rest van de tijd de vrijheid hebt om vanuit huis te werken. Deze aanpak zorgt voor een balans van interactie en flexibiliteit.

  • Teamspirit: Versterk de teamgeest door deel te nemen aan diverse sportevenementen, zoals een tennistoernooi of de singelloop in Breda. Bouw samen met je collega's aan een hechter team.

Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

Your role

As Head of Product, you own our product hands-on. You are the bridge between what the market and our operators need and what we build, turning field feedback and market insight into a clear roadmap and products people actually want to use. You own how our capabilities become real products: how they are shaped, packaged, priced, taken to market, and adopted by the people who use them in the field.

This is a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves role, not a purely strategic one. You set the product’s direction together with the founders, and you do the work to make it happen: talking to users, writing requirements, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to ship. You bring structure to how we do product without turning it into bureaucracy.

You will work closely with the founders, engineering, and commercial. The company strategy is set with the founders; your job is to own the product within it and make it succeed.

Your responsibilities will include

• Product strategy & roadmap. Owning the product roadmap and prioritization, and keeping the product direction aligned with the company strategy as the market and the technology evolve.

• Market-to-technical bridge. Translating operator needs, market signals, and partner requirements into clear, well-scoped work for engineering, and translating technical capability back into value the market understands.

• Hands-on product delivery. Writing requirements, shaping features, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to get things shipped and validated.

• Product portfolio. Helping shape how our capabilities in detection, navigation, interception, and beyond fit together as a modular, scalable line-up rather than isolated tools.

• User experience & adoption. Owning how usable our products are for end users: ease of use, onboarding, training, documentation, and the adoption path from first deployment to routine operational use.

• Pricing & business model. Contributing to pricing, packaging, and business models across the product line-up, and owning the product side of the classic marketing mix (the 4Ps).

• Go-to-market. Partnering with commercial and business development on go-to-market for each capability, from positioning and narrative to capability briefs and demos.

• Market intelligence. Keeping an eye on the market: trends, competitors, adjacent opportunities, and where the next product bets should be.

• Regulatory & compliance awareness. Given the defence context, factoring export control, procurement, and relevant standards into product decisions, working with the right internal and external stakeholders.

• Lightweight product practices. Bringing just enough structure, process, and documentation to make product work repeatable, suited to a fast-moving deep-tech company.

What you will deliver in your first year

• A clear, documented product roadmap, aligned with the founders and understood across the company.

• A working feedback loop that turns field and operational insight into product decisions.

• Well-scoped, prioritized work flowing to engineering, with product shipped and validated with users.

• Input into pricing and business-model choices for the core product lines.

• A joint go-to-market plan with commercial for at least one capability, taken through to execution.

• Measurable improvement in product adoption and usability through better onboarding, documentation, and training for operators and partners.

• A working market map that informs the next set of product bets.

What we expect from you

• 5+ years in product management, with a track record of owning a product’s roadmap and shipping it in a technical product environment.

• Experience in a startup or scale-up environment: comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and wearing several hats.

• A strong bridge-builder: you connect customers and market reality to engineering, and you are comfortable in deeply technical conversations without being the engineer yourself.

• A genuinely hands-on mindset: you want to talk to users, write requirements, and work day-to-day with engineering, not only set direction from a distance.

• Exposure to pricing, packaging, and business-model decisions (the product side of the 4Ps).

• Experience working with commercial teams on go-to-market.

• A user-obsessed attitude: you care about adoption, usability, training, and documentation, not only features.

• The ability to read a market, spot trends, and turn them into concrete product opportunities.

• Strong communication and stakeholder skills, from the field and the shop floor to founders, partners, and government stakeholders.

Nice to have

• Domain experience in defence, drones/UAV, aerospace, or other dual-use or high-stakes technology. A real plus, but not a must.

• Experience navigating regulated environments and their impact on product, such as export control, procurement, certification, or standards.

• Experience as an early or first dedicated product hire, setting up lightweight product practices from scratch.

We know this exact combination is rare. If you have a strong track record of building products that reached real users, and the hands-on drive and judgment to navigate the rest, we want to talk.

What we offer

• The chance to own the product of a deep-tech defence company from an early stage, working directly with the founders.

• Equity participation. We want the people building the company to share in it.

• Competitive compensation.

• 25 vacation days per year.

• Reimbursed travel expenses and company laptop.

• (Really) flexible working hours, with a hybrid setup around our Delft office.

• Working in an international, world-class team of engineers and entrepreneurs solving real-life problems with technology that matters.

• Real ownership, fast iteration, and tight feedback loops, and the chance to see what you build deployed in environments where it genuinely counts.

The application procedure

• We'll get back to you as soon as possible. If we see a potential fit, we'll set up an initial conversation, followed by deeper sessions with the founders and the team where we work through real product scenarios together.

• Welcome to the team!

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. About the Role

Pelico is hiring a Senior Product Manager — Core Platform to own one or more of the shared components that every Pelico product is built on.

Pelico is moving from features built per use case to a platform of configurable components: the data model and the engines that compute on it, the configuration layer, UI building blocks, workflows and actions, and the platform services around them. Solution teams, forward deployed engineers and AI agents combine these components to deliver a use case for a customer. The quality of that base decides how fast Pelico delivers, how well it scales and whether customers trust what they see.

You will own part of that base and run it as a product. Its users are internal teams and agents as much as planners and buyers at customer sites. jobs.title: QA Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Transforming 50M+ daily events into real-time actionable dashboard insights

The Dashboards team is responsible for the systems and interfaces that define our partners' daily operations. We build the campaign management APIs, analytics engines, and high-throughput tools that allow advertisers and publishers to configure, monitor, and optimize their activity on our platform.

This is not about simple CRUD interfaces, it is about building high-performance data surfaces that drive massive business decisions. Using Go, Kafka, and Druid, we process and render real-time analytics across 50+ million daily events, ensuring accuracy and complex campaign performance reporting at scale. On the frontend, we tackle genuine engineering constraints: utilizing TypeScript and React, we have moved beyond standard library limitations to build highly optimized graph-rendering with Recharts capable of visualizing datasets that would overload conventional solutions.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • QA with 3 years+ hands on automation experience, alongside a strong manual testing foundation. You design and execute structured and exploratory test cases, validate complex user journeys across frontend and backend, and perform regression testing before releases. You identify edge cases and risk areas early and document clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira.

  • You contribute to UI and API test automation using Playwright, identify critical regression flows worth automating, and maintain existing test suites. CI/CD integration experience is a plus.

  • API and data testing is part of your toolkit. You test APIs and data-driven dashboard features, and have basic SQL knowledge for backend data validation. You understand what correct looks like at the data layer, not just the UI.

  • Quality ownership from day one. You participate in refinement and sprint planning from a QA perspective, help define acceptance criteria and test strategies, and proactively flag quality risks before they reach release.

  • Plus: Experience in SaaS, AdTech, or performance marketing environments.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other. 

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

Our Mission ⚖️

At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform.

Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard.

Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.

Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that.

Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities.

Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting.

And we're just getting started.


Doctrine employs over 230 people and has been growing steadily and profitably for several years.
In 2025, we are entering a new phase, becoming multi-country and multi-product.
After launching in our first international market, Italy, Doctrine is continuing its global expansion with Germany.
We are therefore looking to several Account Executive in Germany to scale our commercial impact in the German market.
 
A word about the Germany Team ✨
When you join, you’ll be onboarded and supported by your manager, Pascale (Head of New Business), who will help you ramp up and succeed in your role.

  • You are extremely rigorous and detail-oriented

  • Knowledge of the legal sector is a plus
  • Travels within France may be required

    🏡 A flexible remote work policy, allowing up to three days of remote work per week (depending on your team).

    🌴 A flexible leave policy

    🌱 Real internal mobility opportunities

    🏄‍♂️ Regular team events

    💡 Discounts and perks via our Works Council (CSE) on the Happypal platform

    🍏 Brand new Apple equipment

    At Doctrine, our 4 values guide us every day as we work to move things forward.

    Challenge the status quo: we champion bold ideas that drive change across an entire industry.

    Liberty and responsibility: we encourage autonomy, individual impact and ownership.

    Knowledge is power: information is at the heart of Doctrine's mission, and we constantly strive to grow.

    Release early, release often and listen to your customers: we believe in the power of iteration and in constantly listening to our market, our customers and their challenges.

    1. A 30-min intro call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers to understand your career goals and walk you through what we're building at Doctrine.

jobs.title: Data Scientist (mid-snr)
Head of Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
TLDR; Conduct's first revenue operations hire. You will build RevOps from scratch: the systems, planning and data our whole go-to-market team runs on, and make it AI-native from day one.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies compete by being different, and most of that difference lives in the software they've built for themselves, which decides everything from how parcels reach your door to how food gets onto supermarket shelves. That software is a real advantage, but it's also the hardest part of the business to change safely, so good ideas often wait months or even years for the systems to catch up.

Every large enterprise has a software company hiding inside it, and Conduct is building the operating system for it. We read a company's code and processes, work out what needs to change, and help the business and its systems move forward together, wherever custom software has become too complex to change safely.

Fortune Global 500 companies like DHL and Daimler Truck already trust us with their most critical systems, and we've just raised a $60M Series A from Index Ventures, ICONIQ and SAP.

We're a talent-dense team of about 70, growing fast across London and New York, with people from Palantir, G-Research, Legora and Sequoia. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here will shape the company and how the world's largest companies operate.

About the role

Our go-to-market team is growing fast in London and New York, and over the next year we'll scale it several times over, with new account executives and regional directors joining across both offices. They sell a technical product to CIOs and IT leaders at some of the world's largest companies, in long deals with many stakeholders, often alongside partners like SAP and the major consultancies. To grow at that pace, everyone needs one clear picture of the business and an operating rhythm they trust.

Today there's no RevOps function, so you'll be starting from a blank page. You'll decide how we plan, measure and run go-to-market, then build it yourself: the CRM and the systems around it, the planning cycle, the forecast and the analytics that tell leadership where to focus.

We're an AI company, so we expect RevOps to be AI-native too. Agents should do the work that headcount does elsewhere, so a small team can have an outsized impact. You'll work closely with our founders, sales leaders, partnerships, marketing and finance.

What you'll do

  • Build the function from scratch. Hire and lead a small founding team, and set one set of definitions, KPIs and data standards across sales, marketing, partnerships and deployment strategy, so the whole company works from a single source of truth.

  • Own the GTM tech stack. Implement and run the CRM and the tools around it, with clean data captured at the source rather than fixed after the fact.

  • Put agents to work. Design and ship AI workflows for account research, enrichment, routing, pipeline hygiene and forecast inputs, and decide where a human stays in the loop and how the output is checked before anyone acts on it.

  • Run the planning cycle. Own territory and coverage design, capacity and headcount planning, quota setting and comp plan design for enterprise land-and-expand deals.

  • Run the revenue rhythm. Lead forecast calls, pipeline reviews and QBRs, build a forecast leadership can rely on, and deliver board-ready reporting with the story behind the numbers.

  • Set commercial guardrails. Work with our deal desk on pricing discipline, approvals and contracting workflows for complex enterprise and partner deals.

  • Decide where we play next. Turn win/loss, conversion and customer data into decisions, size the market by vertical and geography, and build the case and the infrastructure for new markets.

What we're looking for

  • A track record of building or scaling RevOps at a high-growth B2B software company, ideally one selling complex, technical products to enterprises. You've owned territory design, quota and comp plans, forecasting and pipeline management, and hired the team to run it.

  • Deep, hands-on CRM expertise (Salesforce or HubSpot at admin level) and experience designing an integrated GTM stack.

  • AI-native. You've put AI agents or LLM-powered workflows into production for a business team, and can show what broke, what you changed and the impact. Your default is to automate.

  • Strong analytical skills, including SQL and BI tools, with experience sizing markets and turning data into go-to-market decisions.

  • Equally strategic and hands-on. You design the system and also build the models, dashboards and workflows yourself.

  • A clear communicator who earns credibility with sales leaders, founders and the board.

  • Experience with long enterprise sales cycles, the SAP ecosystem or systems integrator co-sell motions is a strong plus.

  • An appetite for being in the office every day, close to the team and the work.

Your seniority does not matter. Ambition, craft and the ability to turn ideas into high-quality work quickly do. We sponsor visas from everywhere. We're convinced diverse teams build better products, and we especially encourage people from groups underrepresented in tech to reach out.

jobs.title: Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, France
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base. You’ll own the team’s post-sale operating model across onboarding, adoption, value realisation and expansion, while staying directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and growth opportunities.

  • Build practical playbooks, portfolio coverage models and operating cadences that improve customer outcomes, retention, adoption and expansion across payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

  • Improve visibility and predictability across onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, customer health, expansion pipeline, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and retention.

  • Drive a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value.

  • Orchestrate complex level 2 customer issues with Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations, turning recurring friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

  • Partner with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

Within the first 90 days, you’ll have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities, established the team cadence and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues. Within six to twelve months, priority accounts should have clear plans and stakeholder coverage, the core playbooks should be consistently used, leading indicators should improve against an agreed baseline, and the four Account Managers should show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

You'll work from our Paris office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

  • 2+ years of direct people management experience, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

  • Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

  • Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

  • Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

  • Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

  • Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

Preferred

  • Experience in payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

  • Experience with KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

  • Experience managing strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

  • Experience in pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

  • Experience in Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Cyclomedia creates digital representations of the real world, giving professionals the visual data they need to manage assets and infrastructure. We are currently sharpening our commercial strategy. In our setup, Product Management builds the solution, and Product Marketing wins the market. As part of the Marketing department, you keep our messaging strictly focused on customer value. As the owner of our value propositions, you define the go-to-market approach. You build this strategy through direct contact with customers and close alignment with sales and Product Management.   • Positioning & Messaging: Translate technical product capabilities into clear positioning and go-to-market strategies that drive pipeline value and improve lead conversion rates.

  • Commercial Acumen: A proven ability to look from the outside in. You base your strategies on what the buyer needs to hear rather than what the product can do.

  • Ownership: You work independently and possess the maturity to help shape the Product Marketing function as we grow.

What We Offer

jobs.title: Senior UX / Digital Product Designer (Mensch), Schwerpunkt FinTech
jobs.description:
Wir suchen eine:n in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit, im Frankfurter Raum oder mit hoher Reisebereitschaft einen Senior UX / Digital Product Designer (Mensch) mit Schwerpunkt FinTech, der:die den gesamten Prozess digitaler Produktentwicklung souverän beherrscht und Projekte in dynamischen Kontexten und Projektumfeldern eigenverantwortlich führen kann und sowohl strategisch als auch operativ auf Senior-Niveau agiert.

Taikonauten entwickelt digitale Produkte, Services und Plattformen für Organisationen aus Branchen wie Finance, FinTech, Mobility sowie Industrial & Manufacturing. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, ihre digitalen Angebote im Kontext von digitaler Transformation, Produktinnovation und Acceleration strategisch und nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Dabei arbeiten wir explorativ, konzeptionell tief und mit hohem gestalterischem Anspruch – immer mit starkem Fokus auf Nutzerzentrierung.

Unser Anspruch ist es, Produkte von der ersten Problemdefinition bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung im Markt zu begleiten. Neben fachlicher Expertise ist uns vor allem der menschliche Match wichtig. Wenn du Begeisterung für digitale Produktentwicklung mitbringst und aktiv an anspruchsvollen Projekten mitwirken möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Deine Mission

Du führst digitale Produktentwicklungen mit konzeptioneller Klarheit, methodischer Sicherheit und gestalterischer Exzellenz. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe und zunächst unklare Problemstellungen, triffst fundierte Designentscheidungen und argumentierst diese gegenüber Kund:innen und internen Teams. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung – nicht nur für Screens, sondern für Produktqualität, Nutzerzentrierung und Projektdynamik. Du verbindest Business-Ziele mit echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und führst Projekte von der Discovery-Phase bis zur Validierung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kund:innen, Entwickler:innen und interdisziplinären Teams zusammen und setzt Qualitätsmaßstäbe in UX, Visual Design und konzeptioneller Klarheit.

Aufgaben

  • Verantwortung für den gesamten UX- und Product-Design-Prozess (Discovery bis Delivery)

  • Strukturierung unscharfer Problemstellungen (Problem Framing, Scope, Hypothesen)

  • Einbringung deiner fachlichen Perspektive und deines Beratungsstils in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen

  • Entwicklung tragfähiger UX-Konzepte für komplexe digitale Produkte

  • Erstellung von Informationsarchitekturen, User Journeys und End-to-End-Flows

  • Übersetzung von Anforderungen in testbare UX-Spezifikationen

  • Planung und Durchführung qualitativer Research-Formate (Interviews, Tests, Workshops)

  • Strukturierte Synthese von Insights und Ableitung belastbarer Empfehlungen

  • Konzeption und Ausarbeitung visuell hochwertiger UI-Designs und Design-Systeme

  • Moderation von Workshops zur Projektinitialisierung, Zielbilddefinition und Priorisierung

  • Argumentative Vertretung von UX- und Designentscheidungen gegenüber Stakeholdern

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Development-Teams während der Umsetzung

  • Eigenständige Strukturierung komplexer Projektphasen

Qualifikation

Erfahrung & Kompetenz

  • Langjährige Erfahrung im UX / Product Design (5+ Jahre)

  • Mehrjährige Agenturerfahrung mit parallelen Projekten und wechselnden Kunden

  • Fundierte Expertise in fachlich-strategischer UX-Konzeption

  • Nachweisbare End-to-End-Erfahrung in digitaler Produktentwicklung

  • Fundierte Expertise in User Research und quantitativer/qualitativer Analyse

  • Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Hypothesen abzuleiten und zu validieren

  • Sehr hoher Anspruch an visuelle Qualität (Layout, Typografie, Design-Systeme)

  • Strategisches Verständnis von Digital Strategy und Service Design

  • Souveräne Moderation auf Deutsch (mindestens B2, idealerweise C1)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma

Arbeitsweise & Haltung

  • Systemisches Denken und strukturierte Problemanalyse

  • Fähigkeit, Unsicherheit produktiv zu strukturieren

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Selbstorganisation

  • Belastbarkeit in dynamischen Projektumfeldern

  • Fähigkeit, Prioritäten eigenständig zu setzen

  • Anspruch, Designqualität aktiv zu vertreten und zu verteidigen

  • Offenheit und Interesse an KI-Tools sowie KI-gestützten Prozessen und Workflows

  • Bereitschaft, Verantwortung über die reine Designrolle hinaus zu übernehmen

  • Reisebereitschaft über mehrere Tage mit Übernachtungen, auch spontan

Gern gesehen, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit komplexen B2B- oder Enterprise-Plattformen

  • Data Analyse-Erfahrung (Analytics, Conversion-Optimierung)

  • Erfahrung mit agilen Frameworks (Scrum, SAFe o.ä.)

  • Grundverständnis technischer Architektur (APIs, Frontend-Strukturen)

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder der Skalierung von Design-Systemen

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-Tools, sowie Arbeit mit KI-gestützten Prozessen und Workflows

  • Internationale Projekterfahrung

Benefits

Was wir für dich haben

  • Passionierte Kolleg:innen in einer offenen Unternehmenskultur mit flacher Hierarchie

  • Berufliche und persönliche Weiterbildung, gefördert und gefordert

  • Raum für Eigenverantwortung und eigene Ideen

  • Flexible und familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten

  • Ein leidenschaftliches Team, das die soziale und umweltbewusste Zukunft aktiv mitgestaltet

Wie es weitergeht

Du hast Lust, große Schiffe für die digitale Zukunft fit zu machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf dein Portfolio und Lebenslauf oder dem Link zu deiner Website und deine Wünsche für deine berufliche Zukunft zusammen mit uns und einem Hallo.

Bitte verrate uns in deinem Anschreiben, wann du zur Verfügung stehen würdest, zu wievielen Wochenstunden und was dein gehaltswunsch ist.

Wenn wir neugierig auf mehr werden

Dann freuen wir uns auf viele Fragen von dir und ein gutes Kennenlernen.
Denn bei einem ersten positiven Eindruck sprichst du kurz mit Nancy. Im zweiten Gespräch lernst du die Teamleitung kennen. Das dritte Gespräch findet dann mit der Geschäftsführung statt.
Uns ist bewusst, dass das ein langer Weg sein kann, uns ist aber auch wichtig, dass es am Ende ein volles Ja von dir wird, nachdem du die Chance hattest, alle Ebenen deines zukünftigen Wirkens bei den Taikonauten kennenzulernen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager - Enterprise
jobs.description:
The Role

About H

H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential.

H is hiring the world’s best AI talent, seeking those who are dedicated as much to building safely and responsibly as to advancing disruptive agentic capabilities. We promote a mindset of openness, learning, and collaboration, where everyone has something to contribute.

Your role

At H, Product Marketing is the expert on our customers and our market. It decides how H is positioned and differentiated, and makes our value obvious.

H Company is seeking a Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise to help our sales teams win and grow our largest customers. You will own the messaging, enablement and proof that make our enterprise offer easy to understand, easy to trust and easy to buy, in long sales cycles with engineers, business leaders and the C-suite around the table.

This role is ideal for a hands-on product marketer who loves being close to the field and excels at turning complex technology into stories that convert. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Engineers, Product and Marketing to position H as the reference for AI agents in the enterprise.

What you will own

Voice of the customer

  • Capture field feedback (objections, lost deals) and competitive insights to keep our messaging grounded in what AI transformation leaders actually care about

  • Share insights with Product Marketing, Sales and Product to inform positioning and roadmap decisions

Positioning and messaging

  • Adapt our product messaging for each audience (C-level, technical leaders, operational managers), translating technical features into compelling, value-based stories

  • Build and maintain playbooks for our priority industries, use cases and personas

  • Provide key messages and content used in acquisition campaigns

Sales enablement

Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving fast charging to electric drivers. Part of that mission is making car charging as simple as charging your phone, and paying for it should be just as effortless. As a Backend Engineer in the Payments team, you will help make paying for a charge frictionless, secure and reliable. Drivers can pay through the Fastned app, by QR code or with a contactless card at the charger.

The team owns Fastned’s payments domain end to end. That covers integrations with payment service providers and payment terminals. It also covers the services behind payment methods, wallets, pre-authorisation and session payments, billing, invoicing and dunning. The stakes are high: Fastned handles 23,000+ charging sessions a day, and every one of those payments goes through our systems. We’re now moving towards real-time payments, where each session is paid instantly instead of invoiced later. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve.

jobs.title: (Senior) Account Manager - Existing Customers (all genders)
jobs.description:
Description

In ganz Europa stehen Fuhrparks unter enormem Druck. Kraftstoffkosten steigen, regulatorische Anforderungen werden komplexer und der Umstieg auf emissionsärmere Fahrzeuge nimmt Fahrt auf. Gleichzeitig verwalten noch immer rund 70 % der europäischen Unternehmen ihre Flotten mit Excel-Tabellen, isolierten Tools und Prozessen, die für die heutigen Herausforderungen nie ausgelegt waren.

Shiftmove macht genau das einfacher. Wir sind ein profitables B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen und die am schnellsten wachsende Flottenmanagement-Plattform Europas. Entstanden aus dem Zusammenschluss von Avrios und Vimcar, unterstützen wir heute zehntausende Geschäftskunden in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, der Schweiz, Polen und weiteren europäischen Märkten. Mit den jüngsten Akquisitionen von Optimum und Ocean in Frankreich haben wir unsere Präsenz weiter ausgebaut und unsere Position in einem der größten Flottenmärkte Europas gestärkt.

Unsere KI-gestützte Plattform verbindet Fahrzeugdaten in Echtzeit mit intelligenter Software, damit Unternehmen ihre Fahrzeuge smarter beschaffen, Kosten kontrollieren, Compliance sicherstellen und die Mobilitätswende aktiv gestalten können – alles an einem Ort.

Über die Rolle

Als Account Manager:in übernimmst du die kommerzielle Verantwortung für ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum von Shiftmove bei. Dein Ziel ist es, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen nicht nur langfristig zu sichern, sondern ihr Potenzial gezielt auszuschöpfen – durch Renewals, Upselling, Cross-Selling und die Entwicklung neuer Umsatzmöglichkeiten.

Dabei betreust du ein umfangreiches Portfolio an B2B-Kunden mit einem Geschäftsvolumen von rund 4–5 Mio. €. Du erkennst kommerzielle Chancen, gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, führst Vertrags- und Preisverhandlungen und bringst Opportunities erfolgreich zum Abschluss.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Customer Success Team zusammen, übernimmst aber die eigenständige Verantwortung für die kommerzielle Entwicklung deiner Accounts.

Das erwartet dich

  • Account Management & Kundenentwicklung: Du betreust eigenverantwortlich ein Portfolio aus Mid-Market-Kund und ausgewählten Enterprise Accounts. Du behältst den Überblick über deine Accounts, priorisierst Chancen und Risiken und definierst klare nächste Schritte.
  • Renewal Management: Du verantwortest die Verlängerung bestehender Verträge – von der Vorbereitung des Angebots über die Abstimmung mit Kund bis hin zur Preisverhandlung und zum Abschluss.
  • Expansion: Gemeinsam mit Customer Success identifizierst du Upsell- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale und entwickelst daraus konkrete Opportunities. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kund und kannst nachvollziehbar vermitteln, welchen Mehrwert zusätzliche Produkte oder Lösungen für sie schaffen.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du kommunizierst mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner auf Kundenseite und lernst, auch komplexere Entscheidungsprozesse strukturiert zu steuern.
  • Pipeline & Forecasting: Du dokumentierst relevante Entwicklungen in Salesforce und Planhat, hältst deine Opportunities aktuell und erstellst realistische Forecasts für deine Pipeline.

Was du mitbringst

  • B2B Sales Erfahrung: Du bringst ca. 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld, z.B. im Account Management, Existing Customer Sales oder als Account Executive.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick & Closing: Du hast bereits eigenständig Verkaufsgespräche geführt, kommerzielle Verhandlungen gesteuert und Deals erfolgreich abgeschlossen, idealerweise im fünfstelligen Bereich.
  • Portfolio Management: Du hast Erfahrung in der Betreuung und kommerziellen Entwicklung eines größeren Kundenportfolios und weißt, wie du Accounts und Opportunities effektiv priorisierst.
  • Sales Drive & Proaktivität: Du gehst aktiv auf Kunden zu, erkennst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und hast Freude daran, Umsatzpotenziale in konkrete Abschlüsse umzuwandeln.
  • Consultative Selling: Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden und kannst den Mehrwert einer Lösung überzeugend vermitteln, statt dich ausschließlich auf Produktfeatures zu konzentrieren.
  • Lernbereitschaft & Coachability: Du bist offen für Feedback, möchtest dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und probierst gerne neue Ansätze aus.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau.

Warum uns?

  • Produkte mit echtem Impact: Wir lösen reale Herausforderungen für tausende Unternehmen in ganz Europa und machen komplexe Flottenprozesse einfacher, effizienter und datengetriebener.
  • Etwas Sinnvolles skalieren: Als profitables, PE-finanziertes Scale-up mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen verbinden wir Stabilität mit Geschwindigkeit und Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Internationales Umfeld: Über 40 Nationalitäten, Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und Teams in ganz Europa sorgen für spannende Perspektiven und echte Zusammenarbeit.
  • Verantwortung statt Micromanagement: Wir geben Menschen den Freiraum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ideen einzubringen und Dinge voranzutreiben.

Benefits

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Workation: Bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr remote von überall auf der Welt arbeiten
  • Hundefreundliches Büro: Weil tierische Kolleg einfach dazugehören 🐶
  • Weiterentwicklung: 2.000 € jährliches Budget für persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung
  • Benefits nach Wahl: Urban Sports Club, Hrmony, JobRad oder Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket/BVG-Ticket
  • Wellbeing: 1 Mental Health Day plus Zugang zu nilo.health
  • Für Foodies: Kostenloses Mittagessen einmal pro Woche, gemeinsames Frühstück alle zwei Wochen sowie Snacks und Getränke rund um die Uhr 🍕

We mean it!

Mit über 40 Nationalitäten verbindet uns vor allem eines: der gemeinsame Anspruch, Mobilität für Unternehmen einfacher zu machen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven machen unsere Arbeit besser.

Uns ist nicht wichtig, ob dein Lebenslauf perfekt aussieht. Uns interessieren Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Dinge ins Rollen bringen und Lust haben, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen.

Du bist nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Und wenn du im Bewerbungsprozess etwas brauchst oder Anpassungen notwendig sind, sag einfach Bescheid – wir finden eine Lösung.

About DataSnipper

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

For our Customer Success teams, this is where things get exciting.

Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark.

  • Drive Business Transformation: Help customers reimagine their workflows and processes, demonstrating how DataSnipper’s AI-powered capabilities can deliver measurable efficiency gains, cost savings, and quality improvements across audit and finance functions.

  • Trusted Advisor Mindset: Passion for being a strategic partner to customers, building deep trust-based relationships, and driving business transformation that delivers exceptional value.

About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. The role

As Senior Manager, Constructability, you will build and lead Volta's constructability function. Your team will make sure every DSX design and build sequence is buildable, safe and maintainable before it reaches site, across all our AI factories.

This is a senior leadership role. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global E2E DSX Execution, you will own the constructability process end to end, build the team that runs it, and hold the line with designers, contractors and suppliers when buildability risks threaten schedule or cost.

What you will do

Team and process leadership

  • Build and lead a team of constructability specialists covering multiple concurrent sites.

  • Own the global constructability review process at each design stage, with clear gates, decision rights and escalation.

  • Make the call on buildability issues before release for construction, balancing cost, schedule, quality and maintainability.

Sequencing and modular interfaces

  • Set installation and workface strategies aligned with procurement, commissioning and site logistics.

  • Define modular and off-site interfaces with OSM, including module sizes, tolerances, transport and lift constraints.

Assurance and improvement

  • Report constructability risk and performance to delivery leadership and drive changes into the reference design.

Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. jobs.title: Customer Operations Director
jobs.description:
Customer Operations Director 

Do you know how to combine customer focus, commercial awareness and operational excellence? 

 

As Customer Operations Director, you will lead our customer service, order management and sales support teams across our international Building Automation markets.

Your goal is to make sure customers and partners get fast, reliable and consistent service, from their first question to final delivery. 

This role is for a leader who sees the bigger picture and knows how to turn it into effective day-to-day operations. 

 

What will you do? 

You are responsible for the full customer journey after first contact. That covers answering customer questions and requests, processing orders, following up on quotes, and coordinating deliveries and service. You work closely with Sales, Technical Support, Supply Chain and Finance. 

 

You will: 

  • Lead and develop teams across multiple countries: set clear roles, coach team leaders, and manage capacity and service levels. 

  • Bring customer service, order management and sales support together into one way of working, with clear ownership and smooth handovers between teams and countries. 

  • Support Sales: handle incoming requests, follow up on quotes and orders, and keep customer data in the CRM accurate. Sales keeps ownership of accounts, pricing and targets. 

  • Set up a clear process for technical customer questions with our Technical Support team, from first response to escalation. 

  • Work with Supply Chain on product availability and delivery dates, and keep customers and Sales informed when issues come up. 

  • Simplify processes, reduce manual work, and standardize ways of working across countries while respecting local language and market needs. 

  • Work with IT to improve how teams use our CRM, order management system and customer portals. 

  • Use customer feedback and data to improve service, and share insights with Sales and Product. 

  • Lead the organization through change together with HR and country managers, while keeping service levels high. 

 

In addition: 

  • You have 10+ years of experience in customer service, order management and/or sales support in a B2B environment. 

  • You have 5+ years of leadership experience, including managing team leaders and being responsible for service performance. 

  • You have a proven track record of improving processes and leading change, ideally across multiple countries. 

  • You combine commercial awareness with operational discipline. 

  • You have experience with CRM and order management systems, and you know how to turn data into practical improvements. 

  • Experience in building automation, technical products or subscription services is a strong plus. 

  • You are fluent in Dutch and professionally proficient in English. German is a plus. 

  • You are willing to travel regularly between teams and markets. 

 

What you get   
In numbers  

  • A competitive salary based on your experience;  

  • We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more;  

  • 8% holiday allowance;  

  • Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers.  

  

For your own sustainability  

  • Be secured with our pension plan;  

  • Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

  • Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget;  

  • Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football. 

 

Ready to make an impact? 

Do you want to take Customer Operations within Building Automation to the next level and build a strong, scalable and customer-focused organization for our customers and partners? 

Then we would love to meet you. Apply for the position of Customer Operations Director and discover how you can make an impact at Priva.

jobs.title: Chief Content Officer - Berlin
jobs.description:
About RA

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

The mandate

RA is looking for a Chief Content Officer to lead our media team and shape how we tell the story of electronic music and club culture. The role covers every place our voice shows up: editorial, films, audio formats and social output. You'll bring these together as one multimedia strategy, not separate channels.

Content is central to how people discover music and events on RA. You'll make sure it serves the business as well as the culture: driving discovery, supporting promoters and our network, and building RA's long-term relevance.

You'll set the creative vision and empower the team to deliver it with autonomy. You'll bring strong editorial judgement and a clear sense of what RA stands for, thinking quarters and years ahead without losing sight of what goes out this week. You'll own how the team works: formats, frequency, planning and process. A Managing Editor runs this day to day, and section leads report to you. Your job is to set the direction, standards and rhythm, including how AI changes the way the team works.

Responsibilities

Direction

  • Set RA's editorial strategy across all media formats, grounded in RA's scope of coverage and tied to company goals.
  • Build a unified multimedia approach, planning stories across formats and choosing the right outlet, frequency and context for each.
  • Own RA's editorial judgement, point of view and tone. Decide what we cover, how we cover it and where we draw the line.
  • Stay close to the scenes, first-hand and through RA's network around the world, and turn what you see and hear into what RA covers next.
  • Make the final call on sensitive or high-profile content, resolve competing priorities and keep work moving.
  • Work closely with Growth, Product and the network so content drives discovery across RA's platforms and supports the wider business.

Oversight

  • Oversee the execution and efficiency of editorial, films, podcasts, mixes and social, including ambitious flagship and long-form projects.
  • Keep RA's coverage genuinely global, ensuring strong local stories reach a wider audience beyond the usual cities.
  • Shape the editorial direction of content from RA's global network, including Mix of the Day, RA Picks and local coverage, while giving contributors the autonomy and support to do their best work.
  • Bring RA's creative vision to events and live programming, working with the events team on curation.

Standards

  • Hold a high bar on accuracy, cultural ethics and integrity.
  • Work with 23:59, RA's brand studio, so commercial work feels native to RA while protecting editorial independence.

Team

  • Lead and grow a multidisciplinary team of editors, writers, producers, video and audio makers, and social specialists.
  • Work with and develop strong section leads, giving them clear ownership and authority over their areas and offering constructive feedback.

Operations

  • Own the team's operating rhythm with the Managing Editor, so planning, commissioning, production and publishing hold up at pace, seven days a week.
  • Manage budget, resources and schedules.
  • Set objectives and reporting that make performance clear to the team and leadership.

AI

  • Lead how AI is used across the team, in research, fact-checking, production and distribution, wherever it improves quality or speed.
  • Set clear rules for its responsible use, in line with our editorial standards.

Audience

  • Know how audiences find and engage with modern media: long- and short-form video, podcasts, social media and RA's own platforms. Grow reach, engagement and loyalty across all of them.
  • Measure success on relevance and discovery, not reach alone. Use data and audience insight to inform decisions, not replace judgement.

Representation

  • Be a public face for RA in the industry, at events and in the media.
  • Build relationships with artists, labels, promoters, filmmakers and the wider scene.

Who we are looking for

  • A genuine stake in electronic music and club culture. You have an ear to the ground and real curiosity for what comes next, not just what's already happened.
  • A proven leader who's managed multidisciplinary teams and built structures that work without micromanagement.
  • A track record of commissioning ambitious work across written, visual and audio formats, including film, documentary and social projects.
  • Strong cultural judgement, editorial standards and confidence to make difficult decisions.
  • A global perspective, with an understanding of scenes beyond the dominant capitals, and how we can serve them.
  • A proven understanding of modern audience behaviour, distribution, data and AI, as well as experience managing budgets and competing priorities and a track record of connecting content to business outcomes.

What we offer you

  • Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance.
  • Matched pension, or 401k for US staff.
  • Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs.
  • Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch.
  • Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about.
  • A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: ra.co/about/diversity).
  • Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: ra.co/about/community).

More about RA

We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis.

Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it.

RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge.

We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

Our values

  • Electronic music is art.
  • We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music.
  • We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community.
  • We honour the past, present and future of electronic music.
  • We use innovation to empower the community.
  • We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit.
  • We're always front left.

This is a permanent, full- time position based in Berlin in our Berlin Office. This position requires applicants to be based in Berlin and to work from the office three days per week. The annual salary range for this role is €95,000- €120,000. If you have questions about the role, please contact
