jobs.title: Sales Team Lead (mid-market)
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Sales Team Lead (mid-market) ⭐

We're opening Sales Team Lead roles in France to lead some of our growing crews of Account Executives and scale some of our Mid-Market segments addressing companies of 30–300 employees.

In this role, you will own acquisition on one of the Mid-Market segments in France and run the business end-to-end. You'll be hands-on in the field while coaching and scaling a crew of Account Executives to win the associated market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition. We have just passed the one million member milestone, and this is only the beginning. We're accelerating acquisition in France, and Mid-Market is one of the core pillars of that plan.

Why mid-market is exciting at Alan:

  • A large market with real momentum. You'll lead growth on a big B2B segment where our offer is already winning. We have strong references to build on.

  • Faster cycles, real stakes. Deals typically involve HR, Finance and the CEO, and sometimes a broker. Cycles are shorter than in Enterprise, so you see the results of your decisions quickly.

  • A strong product story. Companies in this range want a modern, digital health experience with fair pricing. They also want simple HR administration. This is where Alan stands out against traditional insurers and brokers.

  • Attractive economics. The segment has solid margins and is a key pillar of Alan's path to profitability in France.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of one of the Mid-Market crews in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and building the machine. More precisely, you will:

  • Own the associated Mid-Market acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go-to-market strategy for 30–300 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets.

  • Lead a team of Account Executives:

    • Drive hiring, onboarding and career development as we scale the crew.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow-up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution and pipeline management.

    • Be in the field with the team: joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the crew. Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: a strong feedback culture, clear ownership and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers. Surface customer expectations, patterns and blockers. Make sure they're addressed through the right plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? You may be a great fit at Alan if you... ⭐

  • Have at least 6 years of experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and an advanced level of English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands-on mentality: you love being in the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to mid-market companies (30–300 employees) in multi-stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data-driven and analytical: you know how to use KPIs to drive performance, run analyses and make decisions

  • Have strong cross-functional collaboration skills and an appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Nantes, Biarritz or Annecy

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR, Finance and C-level stakeholders

  • Having already opened or scaled a new segment or market in a fast-growing company

  • Experience selling insurance, benefits, HR tech or SaaS

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

Waarom deze functie?

Deze rol biedt de unieke kans om invloed uit te oefenen op zowel de technische richting als de ontwikkeling van een grote groep professionals. Je werkt in een omgeving waar complexe technologie, internationale samenwerking en persoonlijke groei samenkomen.

Bij Benchmark werk je aan producten die ertoe doen! Daarnaast zijn wij bij uitstek een organisatie waar je vrijheid krijgt, waar ondernemerschap wordt beloond en waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je ideeën tot uitvoering te brengen. We bieden je een dynamische omgeving met de ruimte om snel stappen te maken, door te groeien en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je bent onderdeel van een wereldwijd bedrijf waar de nuchtere Twentse cultuur bewaard is gebleven.

 

Bij ons krijg je uitdagend werk, veel vertrouwen en ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Je werkt met nuchtere collega’s in een informele cultuur, met goede voorwaarden om duurzaam te presteren.

We're looking for a Director of AI Developer Experience to lead our new AI Developer Experience team, reporting to the VP Platform Engineering. You will also own the existing CI and Developer Experience scope.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the Benelux market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up.

First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out how we win in Benelux: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.

You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • First 3 months: Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in Benelux. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.

  • Within 6 months: Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the Benelux market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.

  • After 1 year: Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in Benelux, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle, independently: Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.

  • Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time): Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Partner, CS and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.

  • Drive expansion: Prospect into existing Tellent customers to cross-sell and upsell, e.g. Recruitee customers adding Tellent HR, or Manage customers adding Grow.

  • Sell on value: Run consultative discovery and tailored demos, position on business outcomes, and handle objections, including against key competitors (with support from PMM).

  • Manage deals with discipline: Use mutual action plans, keep HubSpot accurate (including SPICED), forecast reliably and disqualify early.

  • Test and build, alongside selling: Experiment with sales motions, sequences and verticals, help build the playbook with our PMM, and bring customer and competitive insights from the Benelux market back to Product and Marketing.

What You Bring

  • Early-stage DNA: You've sold in a startup or early scale-up and built pipeline and processes where none existed. You know what it means to be an early sales hire.

  • Proven hunter: A track record of self-generating pipeline through outbound and consistently hitting ambitious activity targets. You genuinely enjoy picking up the phone and creating opportunities from scratch.

  • B2B SaaS sales experience: You've closed new business (ideally expansion too) as a fully autonomous AE in a startup or early scale-up, running 1–5 month, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. HR tech experience is a plus, not essential.

  • Self-sufficient and resilient: You don't wait for leads, support teams or perfect processes. You bounce back from rejection and stay disciplined through the ups and downs of building something new.

  • Consultative and data-driven: Strong discovery, demo and negotiation skills. You anchor on value before price and know your numbers (pipeline, conversion, win rate and cycle time).

  • Languages: Fluent English and native or fluent Dutch are required. You'll be responsible for engaging customers and building relationships across the Benelux market.

This role probably isn't for you if you want a structured environment with large support teams and steady inbound, or you're more excited by GTM strategy than by picking up the phone every day.

How We Measure Success

  • Closed-won revenue against target (primary KPI)

  • Daily and weekly outbound activity targets (key leading indicator, especially early on)

  • Self-generated pipeline and coverage

  • Win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy

  • Contributions to the playbook

What We Offer

  • Compensation: €55000–€70000 gross annual base salary, plus commission.

  • Ownership and impact: Real autonomy to shape the sales motion, playbook and market strategy for a growing product line.

  • Hybrid working: Work from our canal-side Amsterdam office 2–3 days per week.

  • International environment: Join a diverse and international team working across multiple markets.

  • Learning & Development: €1,500 annual learning budget and 2 dedicated learning days.

  • Pension & Wellness: Pension plan and wellness perks.

  • Time Off: 28 paid holiday days, plus 2 additional days in 2026.

  • Work from Anywhere: Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.

  • Commuting: Commuting and travel reimbursement.

  • Home Office: €200 home office budget and a work-from-home allowance.

  • Equipment: Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed.

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we're just getting started.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

  • Shape the future of the design system and the global Agent Experience product as an equal partner to engineering, product, and delivery

  • Create and deliver the design strategy for the system in direct partnership with the engineering lead, holding joint accountability for its direction

  • Set and uphold the design and UX quality bar across every contribution, including accessibility, comfortable challenging engineers and designers alike, and being challenged in return

  • Run the contribution process end to end, so teams beyond our own can propose, design, and ship into the system, from first proposal through to full adoption

  • Design, prototype, and ship components yourself, including using AI-assisted tools to move from Figma to production code, built to WCAG 2.2 AA from the start

  • Coach and develop the designers and engineers who build with the system, raising the bar for how people use and contribute to it

  • Represent the design system to stakeholders across the business, advocating for its value and shaping how the wider company understands and invests in it

  • Champion good design and accessibility thinking in architecture and technical decisions, working alongside senior engineering leaders as a peer

What you’ll bring
Ideally you’ll have/be

  • Deep experience designing, building, and evolving a design system at scale, tokens, component APIs, documentation, and governance

  • Strong design and UX judgement, starting from the user, with genuine comfort challenging and being challenged by engineers and other designers

  • Practical knowledge of WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards, with real empathy for designing for users with accessibility needs, not just compliance

  • Confidence working in code, using AI-assisted tools to take a component from design intent through to shipped reality

  • Experience running a contribution or change process across multiple teams or apps, from proposal to full migration

  • A track record setting and delivering technical and design strategy jointly with engineering, iteratively, through genuine ambiguity, not from a finished plan

  • Strong communication skills, able to hold your opinions loosely, and to raise what matters even when it’s inconvenient, across engineering, product, and the wider business

  • Experience mentoring, coaching, and developing other designers

  • A bias to action, comfortable building momentum in the face of real uncertainty

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.


Our Values

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own change and transformation support for go-live readiness for ENGIE France’s migration onto Kaluza as the hands-on lead, from planning through cutover, hypercare and transition towards scaling, so ENGIE’s teams are ready and confident to adopt the platform from day one.

  • Decide the change approach for the programme: stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, training design and business readiness engagement, shaped to ENGIE France’s operating context and owned by their teams.

  • Operate Kaluza’s business readiness governance: stage gates, readiness evidence, risk and dependency tracking and weekly reporting.

  • Partner with the Learning and Adoption Specialist in France to coordinate training, Train the Trainer and knowledge content, so enablement lands throughout each programme increment as we build out and release features via Agile delivery.

  • Be the day-to-day point of contact for ENGIE France on business readiness, change and adoption, giving practical change advice to their transformation leads.

  • Track adoption and operational stability through hypercare, root-cause any shortfall against acceptance criteria, and agree interventions with ENGIE.

  • Improve Kaluza’s readiness playbook: evolve what worked on ENGIE Belgium, test fixes where it falls short in France, and share what you learn with colleagues across Client Delivery to shape the platform’s operational foundations and improvements and to set our global standards.

Day to day, the activities you’ll lead or support include:

  • Change impact and readiness planning: diagnosing the full scope of impacts across roles, workflows, systems and customer experience, then turning them into a prioritised readiness plan sequenced against delivery, migration and release cadence.

  • Stakeholders, sponsors and change networks: mapping stakeholders and influence at workstream level, helping sponsors stay visible and engaged, and shaping the champion, superuser and people-manager networks that carry change into ENGIE’s business.

  • Communications and resistance: supporting ENGIE France’s own communications and engagement strategy, so their teams and customers hear a consistent, positive story about the programme. You’ll help leaders and champions advocate for the change, internally and with customers, and anticipate where resistance may form so you can intervene before it becomes entrenched.

  • Migration and go-live readiness: building the business and operational readiness evidence that enables a smooth transfer to service, measured against the agreed acceptance criteria, and supporting the go-live command centre.

  • Hypercare and stabilisation: agreeing hypercare entry and exit criteria, monitoring stability and adoption signals, and handing over cleanly to ENGIE’s business-as-usual teams.

  • Early releases and workarounds: planning for known limitations in early releases, and reflecting them in training, knowledge and communications so users are never caught by surprise. You’ll work with Release Management so each platform release arrives with the enablement it needs.

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Several years of hands-on change delivery on large platform or systems transformations, with a recognised change management discipline. You solve a wide range of problems creatively and work with little supervision.

  • Experience in regulated, customer-facing operational environments, including live customer account migration, cutover and go-live, where you have shaped the approach rather than only followed one.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management, credible with client programme leads and transformation sponsors.

  • Fluency in French and English, written and spoken.

  • Comfort working with data: you explore adoption and programme data yourself, report on it clearly and challenge decisions when evidence is weak.

  • Commercial awareness: you understand how Kaluza makes money and balance what the client needs against cost, working alongside SI partners and the client’s own change resources without duplicating effort.

What will set you apart: a background in energy retail or utilities, vendor-side experience on a SaaS implementation, and/or knowledge of contact centre operations and technology.

Our Values

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions cette possibilité poste par poste, alors n’hésitez pas à consulter régulièrement notre site carrières pour découvrir de futures opportunités.

Le français et l’anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous remercions de soumettre votre CV en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité du secteur de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les entreprises de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des entreprises innovantes comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Vos missions

  • Piloter, en tant que référent(e) opérationnel(le), l’accompagnement du changement et de la transformation pour la préparation au go-live de la migration d’ENGIE France sur Kaluza, de la planification jusqu’à la bascule, l’hypercare et la transition vers le déploiement à plus grande échelle, afin que les équipes d’ENGIE soient prêtes et confiantes pour adopter la plateforme dès le premier jour.

  • Définir l’approche de conduite du changement du programme : analyse des parties prenantes, évaluation des impacts du changement, conception des formations et mobilisation pour la préparation métier, adaptées au contexte opérationnel d’ENGIE France et portées par leurs équipes.

  • Faire vivre la gouvernance de préparation métier de Kaluza : stage gates, preuves de préparation, suivi des risques et des dépendances, et reporting hebdomadaire.

  • Collaborer avec le ou la Learning and Adoption Specialist en France pour coordonner la formation, le Train the Trainer et les contenus de connaissance, afin que l’accompagnement soit en place à chaque incrément du programme, au fil de la construction et de la livraison des fonctionnalités en mode Agile.

  • Être l’interlocuteur(trice) quotidien(ne) d’ENGIE France sur la préparation métier, le changement et l’adoption, en apportant des conseils pratiques à leurs responsables de transformation.

  • Suivre l’adoption et la stabilité opérationnelle pendant l’hypercare, analyser les causes racines de tout écart par rapport aux critères d’acceptation, et convenir avec ENGIE des actions correctives.

  • Améliorer le playbook de préparation de Kaluza : faire évoluer ce qui a fonctionné sur ENGIE Belgique, tester des correctifs là où cela ne suffit pas en France, et partager vos enseignements avec vos collègues de Client Delivery pour façonner les fondations opérationnelles de la plateforme, ses améliorations et nos standards globaux.

Au quotidien, vous piloterez ou soutiendrez notamment les activités suivantes :

  • Impacts du changement et planification de la préparation : diagnostiquer l’ensemble des impacts sur les rôles, les processus, les systèmes et l’expérience client, puis les traduire en un plan de préparation priorisé, séquencé en fonction du rythme de livraison, de migration et de mise en production.

  • Parties prenantes, sponsors et réseaux du changement : cartographier les parties prenantes et leur influence au niveau de chaque chantier, aider les sponsors à rester visibles et engagés, et structurer les réseaux de champions, de super-utilisateurs et de managers qui porteront le changement au sein du business d’ENGIE.

  • Communication et résistances : soutenir la stratégie de communication et d’engagement d’ENGIE France, afin que leurs équipes et leurs clients entendent un discours cohérent et positif sur le programme. Vous aiderez les dirigeants et les champions à porter le changement, en interne comme auprès des clients, et vous anticiperez les zones où des résistances pourraient apparaître afin d’intervenir avant qu’elles ne s’installent.

  • Migration et préparation au go-live : constituer les preuves de préparation métier et opérationnelle qui permettent un transfert fluide vers l’exploitation, mesurées par rapport aux critères d’acceptation convenus, et soutenir le centre de commandement du go-live.

  • Hypercare et stabilisation : définir les critères d’entrée et de sortie de l’hypercare, suivre les signaux de stabilité et d’adoption, et assurer une passation propre aux équipes d’exploitation d’ENGIE.

  • Premières versions et solutions de contournement : anticiper les limitations connues des premières versions et les refléter dans les formations, les contenus de connaissance et les communications, pour que les utilisateurs ne soient jamais pris au dépourvu. Vous travaillerez avec le Release Management pour que chaque version de la plateforme arrive avec l’accompagnement nécessaire.

Votre profil

Idéalement, vous avez :

  • Plusieurs années d’expérience opérationnelle en conduite du changement sur de grandes transformations de plateformes ou de systèmes, avec une discipline de change management reconnue. Vous résolvez avec créativité une grande variété de problèmes et travaillez avec peu de supervision.

  • Une expérience dans des environnements opérationnels régulés et en contact avec les clients, incluant la migration de comptes clients en production, la bascule et le go-live, où vous avez contribué à définir l’approche plutôt que de simplement en suivre une.

  • De solides compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes, avec une vraie crédibilité auprès des responsables de programme et des sponsors de transformation côté client.

  • Une aisance avec les données : vous explorez vous-même les données d’adoption et de programme, vous en rendez compte clairement et vous challengez les décisions lorsque les éléments factuels sont fragiles.

  • Une sensibilité commerciale : vous comprenez comment Kaluza gagne de l’argent et savez arbitrer entre les besoins du client et les coûts, en travaillant aux côtés des partenaires intégrateurs et des ressources change du client, sans doublonner les efforts.

Ce qui fera la différence : une expérience dans la vente d’énergie aux particuliers ou dans les utilities, une expérience côté éditeur sur une implémentation SaaS, et/ou une connaissance des opérations et des technologies de centre de contact.

Nos valeurs

About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About the Role

This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound.

Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies.

What You'll Do

Own the numbers

• Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation.

• Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance.

• Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report.

• Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations.

• Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO.

Drive the growth agenda

• Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them.

• Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business.

• Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent.

• Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control.

• Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI.

• Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region.

Who We're Looking For

• An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output.

• Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it.

• A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent).

• 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering.

• Ability to lead and build a team of regional finance specialists.

• Comfort operating in a decentralised, multi-entity, PE-backed environment - you'll manage stakeholders across businesses at very different stages of maturity.

• Fluent in English and French; effective communicator at every level of an organisation, from bookkeeper to CEO.

• Ideally, a background in fast-growing technology or SaaS companies.

• Willingness to travel occasionally.

What We Offer

• Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus.

• Remote flexibility.

• A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust.

• Access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem - accelerate your personal and professional growth.

• Regular team events and company celebrations.

Interview Process

Here's what to expect and who you'll meet during the recruitment process:

• First interview with Talent Acquisition Manager (0.5 h)

• Second interview with Hiring Manager (1.0 h)

• Third interview with Group Finance representatives (1.0 h)

jobs.description:
About the role:

As Senior Simulation Engineer – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain, you will play a key role in shaping the simulation capabilities that enable us to develop, test, and validate the next generation of autonomous ground systems at scale. You will design and evolve realistic, reliable, and reproducible virtual environments in which our autonomy software can be developed and challenged long before a physical vehicle enters the field.

You will take strong technical ownership of simulation systems, architecture, and engineering decisions, helping to define how simulation is integrated into our autonomy development and verification workflows. You will tackle complex technical challenges hands-on, challenge existing approaches, identify limitations, and continuously improve the quality, scalability, and effectiveness of our simulation environment.

As a senior engineer, you will also act as a technical sparring partner for other engineers. You will share your expertise, review technical approaches, mentor less experienced colleagues, and contribute to engineering standards and best practices, while enabling teams to retain ownership of their respective systems and decisions.

Working closely with engineers across autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, platform software, verification, and vehicle integration, you will translate complex simulation needs into robust technical solutions. You will help align interfaces and requirements across teams and ensure that our simulation capabilities address real engineering challenges and become an integral part of autonomy development, continuous testing, and system-level verification.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Take technical ownership of simulation capabilities, contributing to the architecture, technical roadmap, and quality of the simulation systems used for autonomy development, testing, and verification.

  • Design and develop scalable simulation solutions, building realistic, reliable, and reproducible environments that enable autonomy software to be tested across complex scenarios before deployment on physical vehicles.

  • Drive strong engineering decisions, leading technical discussions, challenging assumptions, evaluating trade-offs, and helping teams make pragmatic and sustainable architectural choices.

  • Translate autonomy and verification needs into technical solutions, working closely with stakeholders to turn complex requirements into clear simulation concepts, priorities, and implementation plans.

  • Contribute hands-on to complex engineering challenges, investigating technical limitations, improving simulation fidelity and performance, and solving problems that require deep technical expertise.

  • Drive collaboration across the Land Domain, working closely with autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, verification, platform software, and vehicle integration teams to identify where simulation provides the greatest engineering value.

  • Keep simulation closely connected to the real system, using field data, vehicle testing, real-world failures, and operational feedback to continuously improve simulation fidelity, coverage, and relevance.

  • Raise the technical standard across the team, sharing knowledge, reviewing technical approaches, mentoring other engineers, and contributing to engineering standards, development practices, and continuous improvement.

  • Identify technical risks and dependencies early, helping teams address scalability, maintainability, integration, and verification challenges before they become blockers.

  • Act as a senior technical interface for simulation, communicating technical challenges, architectural decisions, dependencies, and opportunities clearly across engineering teams and stakeholders.



What you bring to the team:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in simulation, robotics, autonomous driving, physical systems, vehicle dynamics, software engineering, or closely related engineering domains.

  • Strong technical expertise in simulation and autonomous systems, with experience designing, building, and evolving complex simulation environments used for development, testing, and verification.

  • A strong software engineering background, ideally including modern C++ and Python, with hands-on experience building or extending simulation infrastructure using technologies such as CARLA, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Unreal Engine, Gazebo, or comparable simulation environments.

  • Solid understanding of physical simulation and autonomous systems, including areas such as vehicle dynamics, sensor simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SiL), scenario-based testing, and the trade-offs between simulation fidelity, performance, determinism, and scalability.

  • Experience taking technical ownership of complex systems, contributing to architecture and technical roadmaps while driving decisions around scalability, maintainability, reliability, and system quality.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Your decisions here won't get lost in a big system. They'll define it.

As Staff Backend Engineer for Manychat for Brands, you’ll own the technical side of a new product. You’ll set the architecture and technical priorities with the team, and decide what lives in our Python services and what stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. It’s an individual contributor role with a lot of room to make an impact.

The product fills a real gap. Brands pay influencers to post but then can’t see what happens next. We’re building the first view that shows it: who asked for the link, who opened the DM, who clicked, for every campaign, creator and post.

You’ll work with Product as a partner and stay close to brands and creators, so feedback reaches you fast and helps you shape Manychat for Brands.

Sound like you? Let’s talk!

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the Engineering team:

We keep Manychat running smoothly under high load every single day and make sure it's ready to scale even further. We do it by combining strong engineering foundations with AI tools that let us move faster without cutting corners. And we're the ones who shape and own what gets built. AI accelerates. Humans own the thinking.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

  • Set the architecture and technical priorities for Brands together with the Engineering Manager and the team: service boundaries, data models, authentication, access control, and integration with the core Manychat platform.

  • Decide which logic belongs in the Python-based Brands services and which stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. Think about data ownership, reliability, and long-term maintenance.

  • Lead big system-level changes when the path isn't clear yet. Explore options, split the work into measurable milestones, and plan data migrations, gradual rollouts, and rollbacks.

  • Define reliability and performance requirements for key Brands workflows. Set metrics and observability, and check the impact of your changes on production data.

  • Find the root causes of slowdowns and repeated incidents across service boundaries, using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

  • Work with Security, Infrastructure, and Platform teams on solutions. Decide what to fix in the application and what needs other teams, and explain the trade-offs clearly.

  • Work with Product on the approach and scope of solutions, and suggest simpler options when you see them.

  • Make technical decisions easy to follow: document key choices and the reasons behind them, do thorough design and code reviews, and share your knowledge in complex areas.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • Deep expertise in Python backend development and a broad view of backend architecture beyond one language. You can understand existing systems, even when the technology is new to you.

  • A strong product mindset. You work closely with Product Managers, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade-offs in terms of user experience, timelines, and product capabilities.

  • Experience owning the architecture and production operations of a product or a large technical area, not only delivering separate features.

  • A solid understanding of distributed systems and data flows: API contracts, async processing, data consistency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.

  • Knowledge of how backend applications are deployed and run in production: configuration, networking, and external dependencies.

  • Knowledge of application security basics: authentication, authorization, data isolation, and access management.

  • Comfort in a fast-changing environment. Things can shift quickly here, and the team relies on everyone's proactivity and ownership.

  • Strong English for technical and product discussions and for documentation.

It would be great if you have:

  • Hands-on PHP experience, on top of understanding how our Python and PHP systems work together.

  • Experience with ETL/DWH pipelines and analytics systems.

  • Experience with environment configuration, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Experience improving AI-assisted software development practices.

Our tech stack: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery. Our services integrate with Manychat's PHP-based platform. Everything runs on AWS and Kubernetes, with Terraform/Terragrunt for infrastructure. You don't need hands-on experience with every tool. Technical depth and the ability to reason about complex systems matter most.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

  • 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family.

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family.

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

  • 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster.

This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. About Airwallex

Airwallex is seeking highly skilled Sanctions Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our second line of defense (2LoD) Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team. In this role, you will act as the ultimate regional escalation point for L3 sanctions alerts to advise on complicated sanctions matches, drive sanctions investigations and efficacy of sanctions screening, determine potential reporting obligations, and assist in scaling a global sanctions program. This role requires a strategic thinker who can seamlessly translate complex regional regulatory changes into practical, scalable control enhancements across the business and multiple geographies.

Responsibilities

  • Act as an in-region Sanctions Subject Matter Expert (SME) and serve as the second-line escalation point for highly complex, ambiguous sanctions matches, special investigations, and potential block-and-reject.

  • Own L3 Sanctions case investigation and decisioning regionally, assessing applicable reporting, disclosure, and recordkeeping obligations.

  • Provide practical, timely, and risk-based sanctions advice on complex cross-border payment flows, indirect exposure, jurisdictional conflicts, new products and services, customer segments, commercial transactions, and geographic expansion.

  • Own and maintain regional Sanctions operational procedures and provide effective second-line oversight of sanctions controls implemented by first-line teams, ensuring alignment with the Global Sanctions Policy while incorporating applicable local requirements.

  • Liaise with global teams to provide actionable feedback on product-specific controls and screening technologies, leveraging in-region expertise and historical L3 escalations to ensure continuous optimization and alignment with the organization’s risk appetite.

  • Monitor US, regional, and international sanctions and export-control developments, geopolitical events, and regulatory expectations, assessing their impact on customers, products, jurisdictions, lists, systems, procedures, and risk appetite.

  • Develop and deliver targeted training and ongoing guidance for L2 sanctions reviewers, KYC, Operations, and other stakeholders on sanctions risk, alert adjudication, investigative research, discounting criteria, escalation standards, and documentation requirements.

  • Lead responses to banking partners and other external stakeholders on sanctions-related inquiries and due diligence reviews.

Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of relevant experience, preferably at a fintech, payments company, or large financial institution specializing in sanctions.

  • Experience managing sanctions alerts at the L3 level, recommending blocking/freezing transactions, assessing sanctions-related licenses and respective transactional permissibility, and managing reporting.

  • History of assessing current sanctions frameworks and recommending enhancements to strengthen the program, including designing and scaling sanctions programs.

  • Demonstrated understanding of in-region sanctions regulations and industry best practices pertaining to economic sanctions; knowledge of US sanctions in addition to in-region expertise is strongly preferred.

  • History of executing the operationalization of sanctions controls in collaboration with technological teams, adhering to global policies, in-region procedures, and risk appetite.

  • A history of interacting or supporting engagement with external stakeholders such as regulators or financial institution partners on sanctions matters.

  • Expert knowledge of financial and trade sanctions within the European Union (EU) framework and UK regulations administered by the Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) and corresponding export control bodies.

  • Strong understanding of the EU/UK Blocking Statute and how to navigate conflicting regulatory obligations within European jurisdictions and the UK.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Sharing this story with the world is just as important as the science and engineering behind it.

We're looking for a creative, proactive, and digitally savvy Social Media Manager to build and grow our social media presence, starting with LinkedIn. As our first dedicated social media hire, you'll have the opportunity to establish our social media strategy, develop a consistent content engine, and bring Focused Energy's innovations, people, and progress to life for audiences around the world.

You'll work closely with our Communications team and subject-matter experts across science, engineering, and business to turn complex technical developments into engaging, accessible content. From employer branding and thought leadership to company milestones and community engagement, you'll help shape how the world sees and connects with Focused Energy.

This is an exciting opportunity to build something from the ground up, take ownership of growing digital channels, and help amplify the story of a company working at the forefront of clean energy innovation.

What You'll Do

  • Own Our Social Media Presence: Lead the day-to-day strategy, planning, and execution of Focused Energy's LinkedIn presence, including content development, publishing cadence, and channel growth.

  • Build a Scalable Content Strategy: Establish and maintain an editorial calendar, repeatable content formats, and workflows that keep our social channels consistent, engaging, and aligned with company priorities.

  • Bring Our Story to Life: Partner with the Digital Content Creator and internal subject-matter experts to transform complex scientific, technical, and business developments into compelling content that resonates with external audiences.

  • Drive Employer Branding and Thought Leadership: Develop content that highlights our people, culture, technical expertise, company milestones, partnerships, and innovations to strengthen our reputation and support talent attraction.

  • Grow and Engage Our Community: Manage day-to-day community interactions, responding to followers, candidates, partners, and other audiences in a timely, authentic, and on-brand manner.

  • Explore New Opportunities: Evaluate emerging platforms and additional social channels, making recommendations on where and how Focused Energy should expand its digital presence.

  • Measure and Optimize Performance: Track key social media metrics, analyze audience engagement and content performance, and use insights to continuously improve our strategy, formats, and publishing approach.

  • Support Campaigns and Key Initiatives: Coordinate social media activity around company announcements, events, product and technology milestones, partnerships, and recruiting campaigns.

  • Maintain Brand and Content Standards: Ensure all published content reflects Focused Energy's voice, brand identity, and communication standards, working with the appropriate stakeholders to validate scientific accuracy and manage sensitive topics.

  • Support Paid and Organic Social Activity: Execute organic social initiatives and contribute to paid social campaigns within approved strategies and budgets.

Who You Are

  • You have a degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You bring hands-on experience managing social media channels for a company, brand, startup, or organization, with a strong understanding of LinkedIn and its role in B2B marketing, employer branding, and thought leadership.

  • You have a strong grasp of social media strategy, content marketing, audience engagement, and the platform mechanics that drive visibility and growth.

  • You're an excellent writer and storyteller who knows how to turn complex ideas, technical information, and company updates into clear, engaging content for external audiences.

  • You have experience building editorial calendars, managing publishing schedules, and creating repeatable content processes that balance proactive planning with real-time opportunities.

  • You're comfortable using social media scheduling, publishing, and analytics tools to monitor performance, report on results, and optimize content. Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager or similar paid social platforms is a plus.

  • You bring a creative mindset and an eye for what makes content relevant, compelling, and shareable, with an understanding of how visual and video content can strengthen social storytelling.

  • You're proactive and self-directed, comfortable building a function from the ground up while keeping leadership informed and seeking alignment on larger strategic decisions.

  • You're a strong collaborator who can build relationships across different teams, engage subject-matter experts, and make it easy for colleagues to contribute their knowledge and stories.

  • You demonstrate sound judgment and attention to detail, particularly when communicating technical developments, company progress, and potentially sensitive information publicly.

  • You're curious, adaptable, and excited by the opportunity to help tell the story of a company pushing the boundaries of science, technology, and clean energy.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

In this role, you will be a key driver of our mission to reimagine energy and make net-zero a reality for everyone. As a Customer Enablement Specialist, you will be the bridge between our innovative technology and the people who use it. You will empower our clients, partners, and colleagues in French-speaking markets to not only understand our platform but to master it - including the AI-powered capabilities we are continuously building and rolling out. Your work will directly accelerate Kaluza's growth by ensuring our users are confident, capable, and ready to support the energy transition.

Strategic Training & Programme Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor to our clients, partners, and internal teams, performing deep learning needs analysis to understand their unique operational challenges. You'll manage your workstream with genuine project and programme management discipline - planning, sequencing and tracking delivery within complex, multi-stakeholder client programmes, ideally drawing on agile ways of working to stay responsive as scope evolves.

Content Creation & Delivery: You will be the master of making the complex simple. You'll create high-quality, engaging training materials in both French and English, including interactive workshops, e-learning modules, and quick reference guides - translating not just today's platform, but AI features and products still in development, into training that's ready the moment they go live. You'll deliver these sessions virtually and in-person, inspiring your audience and building their confidence with every interaction.

Driving Adoption & Impact: Your role is to accelerate the adoption of the Kaluza platform. You will provide post-training support and coaching, monitor the effectiveness of your programmes, and continuously iterate based on feedback and performance metrics. You'll ensure our training leads to real-world, positive change for our users and the energy industry.


What you'll bring 

Ideally you’ll have:

  • Bilingual Fluency, to a high standard: You are fluent in both French and English, with outstanding written and spoken communication skills - essential for day-to-day stakeholder management across multiple countries, up to and including executive level.

  • Operational & Technical SaaS Training Expertise: A proven track record designing and delivering training in a SaaS or technology environment, ideally with hands-on experience of operational or technical instructional training rather than generalist L&D delivery.

  • Project & Programme Management Experience: Strong project and/or programme management experience gained within complex, multi-stakeholder environments; experience of agile delivery is a strong advantage.

  • Operational Experience: Demonstrable experience gained within an operational environment - energy sector operations and/or contact centre settings are especially valued - giving you a first-hand understanding of the pressures and workflows your training needs to support.

  • AI Fluency: Demonstrable experience building, productionalising, or delivering training on AI features and products while they are still in development, and genuine confidence working with AI tools as part of your own everyday practice.

  • Simplification Master: You possess a natural ability to take complex technical and business concepts and translate them into clear, engaging, and practical learning materials.

  • Engaging Facilitator: You are a confident and dynamic presenter, able to captivate diverse audiences and create a fun, interactive learning environment.

  • Collaborative & Proactive: You are a team player who builds strong relationships and is proactive in identifying opportunities to support others and drive continuous improvement.

What will set you apart 

  • Energy Sector Acumen: A practical background in energy utility operations or decarbonisation technologies, beyond the operational experience above, that lets you connect training directly to the real-world challenges our clients face.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Account Executive  - DACH
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the DACH market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up.

First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out how we win in DACH: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.

You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • First 3 months: Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in DACH. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.

  • Within 6 months: Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the DACH market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.

  • After 1 year: Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in DACH, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle, independently: Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.

  • Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time): Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Partner, CS and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.

  • Drive expansion: Prospect into existing Tellent customers to cross-sell and upsell, e.g. Recruitee customers adding Tellent HR, or Manage customers adding Grow.

  • Sell on value: Run consultative discovery and tailored demos, position on business outcomes, and handle objections, including against key competitors (with support from PMM).

  • Manage deals with discipline: Use mutual action plans, keep HubSpot accurate (including SPICED), forecast reliably and disqualify early.

  • Test and build, alongside selling: Experiment with sales motions, sequences and verticals, help build the playbook with our PMM, and bring customer and competitive insights from the DACH market back to Product and Marketing.

What You Bring

  • Early-stage DNA: You've sold in a startup or early scale-up and built pipeline and processes where none existed. You know what it means to be an early sales hire.

  • Proven hunter: A track record of self-generating pipeline through outbound and consistently hitting ambitious activity targets. You genuinely enjoy picking up the phone and creating opportunities from scratch.

  • B2B SaaS sales experience: You've closed new business (ideally expansion too) as a fully autonomous AE in a startup or early scale-up, running 1–5 month, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. HR tech experience is a plus, not essential.

  • Self-sufficient and resilient: You don't wait for leads, support teams or perfect processes. You bounce back from rejection and stay disciplined through the ups and downs of building something new.

  • Consultative and data-driven: Strong discovery, demo and negotiation skills. You anchor on value before price and know your numbers (pipeline, conversion, win rate and cycle time).

  • Languages: Fluent English and native or fluent German are required. You'll be responsible for engaging customers and building relationships across the DACH market.

This role probably isn't for you if you want a structured environment with large support teams and steady inbound, or you're more excited by GTM strategy than by picking up the phone every day.

How We Measure Success

  • Closed-won revenue against target (primary KPI)

  • Daily and weekly outbound activity targets (key leading indicator, especially early on)

  • Self-generated pipeline and coverage

  • Win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy

  • Contributions to the playbook

What We Offer

  • Compensation: €55000–€70000 gross annual base salary, plus commission.

  • Ownership and impact: Real autonomy to shape the sales motion, playbook and market strategy for a growing product line.

  • Hybrid working: Work from our canal-side Amsterdam office 2–3 days per week.

  • International environment: Join a diverse and international team working across multiple markets.

  • Learning & Development: €1,500 annual learning budget and 2 dedicated learning days.

  • Pension & Wellness: Pension plan and wellness perks.

  • Time Off: 28 paid holiday days, plus 2 additional days in 2026.

  • Work from Anywhere: Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.

  • Commuting: Commuting and travel reimbursement.

  • Home Office: €200 home office budget and a work-from-home allowance.

  • Equipment: Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed.

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we're just getting started.

AI in Our Recruitment Process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we're happy to help.

Du suchst eine Architekturrolle, bei der du nicht in einem jahrzehntelang gewachsenen IT Umfeld nur bestehende Strukturen optimierst? Als Lead Architekt & Platform Engineer erhältst du die Möglichkeit, zentrale Teile einer modernen Cloud und Plattformarchitektur neu aufzubauen und dabei Standards, Integrationsmuster und technische Leitplanken selbst mitzugestalten. Bewirb dich jetzt und baue die technologische Grundlage für die nächste Entwicklungsstufe des Unternehmens mit auf.

Deine Benefits als Lead Architekt & Platform Engineer

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Baue moderne Cloud und Plattformarchitekturen mit auf und entscheide mit, welche Technologien und Standards langfristig zum Einsatz kommen. 

  • Flexibilität: Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag weitgehend selbst und arbeite flexibel aus dem Homeoffice oder deinem Wohnort in Deutschland. Für wichtige Workshops und Termine wird deine Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme vor Ort erwartet. 

  • Workation: Nutze bis zu vier Wochen Workation innerhalb der EU und nach Absprache gegebenenfalls darüber hinaus. 

  • Altersvorsorge: Profitiere von einer betrieblichen Altersversorgung mit 50 Prozent Arbeitgeberbeteiligung. 

  • Entwicklung: Nutze individuelle Weiterbildungen, Sprachkurse und persönliche Lernangebote. 

  • Umfeld: Arbeite mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und hoher Eigenverantwortung in einem internationalen Umfeld. 

  • Vergütung: Freue dich auf ein attraktives Gesamtpaket mit variablem Anteil, das deiner Erfahrung und technischen Expertise entspricht. 

Deine Aufgaben als Lead Architekt & Platform Engineer

  • Architektur: Entwickle die Cloud Zielarchitektur sowie Microservices, Data Layer und AI Services weiter. 

  • Cloud Plattform: Gestalte Landing Zones, Netzwerke, Identity Konzepte und Governance Strukturen. 

  • DevOps: Entwickle Standards für CI/CD, Releases und Infrastructure as Code. 

  • Integration: Definiere Architektur und Integrationsmuster für APIs, Events und Batch Schnittstellen. 

  • Security: Berücksichtige Security, Monitoring, Resilienz, Hochverfügbarkeit und regulatorische Anforderungen. 

  • Data & AI: Übersetze Data und AI Strategien in konkrete Architekturbausteine und Integrationsmuster. 

  • Sparring: Unterstütze Development, Infrastructure, Security und Fachbereiche bei technischen Entscheidungen. 

Dein Profil

  • Studium: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im IT Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. 

  • Architektur: Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Solution, Cloud oder Enterprise Architekt in komplexen IT Landschaften. 

  • Hands on: Praktische Programmiererfahrung und ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis. 

  • Cloud: Sehr gute Kenntnisse moderner Cloud, Netzwerk und Identity Architekturen sowie idealerweise Azure Erfahrung. 

  • Technologien: Erfahrung mit Microservices, APIs, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code und modernen Plattformarchitekturen. 

  • Branche: Erfahrung in Banking, Versicherung, Investment oder einem vergleichbaren Finanzumfeld sowie in modernen Cloud oder SaaS Umgebungen. 

  • Kommunikation: Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Entscheidungen verständlich zu vermitteln. 

Du hast genug davon, bestehende Strukturen nur Stück für Stück zu optimieren und möchtest wieder etwas von Grund auf aufbauen? Dann ist jetzt der richtige Zeitpunkt, deine Erfahrung in eine neu entstehende IT-Architektur einzubringen.

Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Qualifications
