About the role

We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives.

This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market.

You will develop a deep understanding of Neural Concept’s technology and work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create and continuously improve how our platform is explained to enterprise audiences.

Your work will directly shape how global enterprises perceive Neural Concept: not as a point solution, but as an intelligence layer that brings AI into engineering workflows, helping Global 2000 engineering leaders design better products faster.

This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex topics, shape Neural Concept’s technical and market narrative, and potentially grow into leading a product marketing team as the company scales.

What you will do

Technology & Product Narrative

  • Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap.

  • Act as a primary internal reference for market-facing technology and product narratives.

  • Turn complex technical concepts into clear explanations, examples, and value stories for engineering and executive audiences.

  • Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging.

Messaging & Positioning Framework

  • Structure and maintain the core messaging framework in collaboration with leadership and Sales Enablement.

  • Define how Neural Concept’s technology is positioned across personas, industries, and use cases.

  • Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns).

  • Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way.

Content Strategy & Creation

  • Own and produce technology- and product-driven content across flagship assets (hero blogs, whitepapers, product pages, decks).

  • Translate ongoing technical innovation into concrete, high-quality content that can be used externally by customers, partners, and sales teams.

  • Partner with the Design team to shape and produce high-quality product and technology content, including diagrams, visual explanations, demos and videos.

Go-to-Market Foundations (in collaboration)

  • Produce use-case content, value stories, and messaging inputs that Sales Enablement and Marketing actively use in customer conversations and campaigns.

  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement to ensure product and technology narratives are translated into clear, consistent sales messaging.

  • Support entry into new industries or use cases by clarifying positioning and value stories, without owning sales strategy or execution.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Applied Engineering, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Leadership.

  • Act as a bridge between technical teams and market-facing functions.

  • Contribute to strategic discussions on positioning, category evolution, and long-term narrative.

Who you are

Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in technology marketing, technical product marketing, or market-facing technical roles within B2B or deep-tech companies.

  • You combine technical depth with a strong sense for marketing and storytelling, whether you built it in a marketing role or on the technical side.

  • Demonstrated ability to deeply understand complex technology platforms and systems, and reason about how they create value in real-world engineering workflows.

  • Engineering background (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or computational engineering) or hands-on familiarity with CAD, CAE, or simulation tools is a strong plus.

  • Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs into clear market positioning.

  • Proven ability to structure and maintain coherent messaging and positioning frameworks grounded in technical reality.

  • Track record of producing substantial, high-quality marketing content for complex technical products.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message to very different audiences, from engineers and technical experts to executives, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking the right questions to build accurate, credible market narratives.

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken.

Ways of working

  • Able to drive complex topics from exploration to execution.

  • Able to operate with a high degree of autonomy while staying closely aligned with leadership and peers.

  • Execution-oriented, pragmatic, and hands-on.

  • Open, direct, and collaborative in working across functions.

  • Energized by a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. You adapt quickly, stay ahead of change, and are willing to challenge your own choices and iterate on them.

  • Genuine passion for technology, engineering, innovation, and AI. You naturally follow what’s happening in the field, enjoy exploring how new technologies change the way products are designed, and have a strong appetite for learning and continuous improvement.

  • Proactive and eager to step in beyond the core scope when projects call for it, contributing to product-related communications such as events, press releases, website updates, or newsletters.

What you get

  • Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)
jobs.description:
Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)

Assen | 38 uur | Schaal 10

Het mooie van werken bij Univé

Wil jij een belangrijke rol spelen in de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening? Ben jij een ervaren businessanalist die complexe processen doorgrondt, inhoudelijk richting geeft en graag zelf met beide benen in de praktijk staat?

Binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies werken we aan de migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics. Een uitdagende verandering waarbij niet alleen technologie, maar vooral onze bedrijfsprocessen en de dienstverlening aan onze leden centraal staan.

Als Senior Business Analist krijg jij de ruimte om deze verandering inhoudelijk vorm te geven. Je voert zelfstandig complexe analyses uit, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat businessbehoeften worden vertaald naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren businessanalist die overzicht houdt in complexe verandertrajecten. Je begrijpt hoe bedrijfsprocessen, informatievoorziening en IT-systemen samenhangen en weet deze kennis te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen.

Je bent inhoudelijk sterk, maar vindt het minstens zo belangrijk om collega's verder te helpen.

Je wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je neemt initiatief, stelt kritische vragen en durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe business- en procesanalyses binnen een IT-omgeving.

  • Kennis van en ervaring met zowel Synergy als Microsoft Dynamics.

  • Ervaring met het analyseren en vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen naar functionele requirements.

  • Het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken zelfstandig uit te werken en anderen daarin mee te nemen.

  • Ervaring met het inhoudelijk begeleiden en coachen van collega-analisten.

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en het verbinden van business en IT.

  • Kennis van Agile/Scrum en het werken in multidisciplinaire teams.

Ervaring met systeemmigraties, juridische dienstverlening of de verzekeringsbranche is een pré.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Business Analist werk je binnen het Rechtshulp Synergy-team aan de vernieuwing van het applicatielandschap voor onze juridische dienstverlening.

De migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics vormt een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw werkzaamheden.

Je brengt bestaande processen en informatievoorziening in kaart, onderzoekt welke verbeteringen mogelijk zijn en vertaalt deze naar heldere requirements voor de nieuwe omgeving.

Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de techniek. Je begrijpt welke impact veranderingen hebben op medewerkers, processen en uiteindelijk onze leden.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

  • Het zelfstandig uitvoeren van complexe business- en procesanalyses.

  • Het analyseren van bestaande Synergy-processen en het vertalen hiervan naar de gewenste inrichting binnen Dynamics.

  • Het ophalen, uitwerken en valideren van businessrequirements, user stories en acceptatiecriteria.

  • Het inzichtelijk maken van afhankelijkheden tussen processen, applicaties en andere IT-teams.

  • Het adviseren van de Product Owner en businessstakeholders over oplossingsrichtingen en verbeterkansen.

  • Het inhoudelijk begeleiden van andere businessanalisten en bewaken van de kwaliteit van analyses.

  • Het ondersteunen bij de voorbereiding en acceptatie van nieuwe functionaliteiten.

  • Het actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling en de verdere professionalisering van businessanalyse.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Binnen de eerste zes maanden heb je de belangrijkste Rechtshulp-processen geanalyseerd en vertaald naar bruikbare requirements voor Dynamics.

Daarnaast heb je inhoudelijk richting gegeven aan de migratie en een zichtbare bijdrage geleverd aan de kwaliteit en zelfstandigheid van de andere analisten.

Je team

Je komt terecht in het Rechtshulp Synergy-team binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies.

Het team maakt onderdeel uit van IT Distributie, waar we nauw samenwerken met onze businesscollega's om de dienstverlening van Univé continu te verbeteren.

Je werkt in een team waarin medewerkers veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid krijgen. We verwachten dat je zelfstandig kunt werken, initiatief toont en actief de samenwerking opzoekt.

Als senior krijg je een belangrijke inhoudelijke rol, zonder dat je formeel leidinggevende bent.

Je bent iemand bij wie collega's terechtkunnen voor complexe vraagstukken, maar die ook zelf graag de inhoud induikt.

Je standplaats is Assen.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Univé krijg je een uitdagende functie waarin je direct bijdraagt aan de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening.

Je krijgt ruimte om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je vakinhoudelijke kennis in te zetten en collega's verder te helpen.

De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 10.

Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring ligt de salarisrange tussen € 65.807 en € 94.551 bruto per jaar, op basis van een 38-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning.

Daarnaast bieden we onder andere:

  • Een variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris.

  • Een arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd.

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek.

  • Een goede studiekostenregeling en mogelijkheden voor professionele ontwikkeling.

  • Een goede pensioenvoorziening.

  • Vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken.

  • Korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatie zonder winstoogmerk. We helpen onze leden risico's te voorkomen, gevolgen te beperken en problemen op te lossen.

Binnen Juridisch Advies ondersteunen we leden bij juridische vragen en problemen. Goede digitale ondersteuning helpt onze collega's om deze dienstverlening persoonlijk, toegankelijk en efficiënt te houden.

IT Distributie speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. We ontwikkelen en verbeteren de IT-oplossingen waarmee onze collega's hun werk kunnen doen en onze leden goed geholpen worden.

Daarbij geloven we in eigenaarschap, samenwerking en de ruimte om zelf verbeteringen aan te dragen.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij jouw ervaring met Synergy en Microsoft Dynamics inzetten om onze juridische dienstverlening toekomstbestendig te maken?

En krijg je energie van een rol waarin je complexe analyses combineert met het begeleiden van collega's?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Solliciteer op de functie van Senior Business Analist Rechtshulp bij Univé.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Engineering team

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5, that looks like this.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 5 we'll also look for

  • Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

  • Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

  • Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
jobs.description:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

Role Overview

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.

  • You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness.

  • You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.

  • You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.

  • Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.

  • You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on, high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast.

 

What we expect from you

  • Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact.

  • Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps.

  • Lead complex cross-functional programmes across Finance, Tech and Operations, driving delivery through stakeholders and teams beyond your direct reporting line.

  • Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream.

  • Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting.

  • Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n.

  • Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build.

  • Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out.

  • Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard.

 

What we look for

You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.

  • A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit.

  • Strong understanding of finance processes, ideally gained through finance transformation, operating model redesign or automation programmes.

  • Hands on with AI. You can build agents and integrate APIs with AI assistance. You are not a software engineer and you do not need to be, but the tooling does not scare you.

  • You set baselines, name owners, hit deadlines, and say so early when something slips.

  • You can lead a small team and still do the work yourself.

  • You prioritise by impact and move fast. Better done than perfect.

  • You bring finance, tech and operations along with you.

  • Fluent in English. other languages will be an advantage.

  • Regular travel to Prague HQ required (min. 4 days per month)

What we offer

  • Unlimited vacation days to support a healthy work-life balance

  • Monthly vouchers: €45 tax-free via become.1

  • €20 monthly internet allowance

  • Knuspr Xtra account and 10% discount in the form of Knuspr credits / cashback

  • Great discounts through Corporate Benefits – fitness, travel, tickets, shopping and much more

  • Real growth: we’re not a traditional corporate.

  • Knuspr vibe: an international team, flat hierarchy, and a first-name culture where mistakes are seen as opportunities to learn

jobs.description:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Platform squads

Pelico is a configuration-driven, AI-native platform: a field engineer stands up a running factory application by authoring YAML — schema, algorithms, widgets, actions, agents — instead of writing code. The Platform squads build the reusable blocks that make that possible, and we run them as a product: our customers are other engineers — the Solution squads, our Regional Solution Engineering pods, and customer AI teams building on top of us.

You'll lead one squad — the configurability framework, the compute layer, the widget surface, the agent-development substrate (MCP/LSP/harness/BYOM), the integration layer, or the end-user Copilot — owning a capability cluster the whole company builds on.

Your mission

You'll own a platform capability end to end — and ship it yourself:

  1. Build the substrate. Author the framework, SPI, runtime, or AI tooling other squads depend on, and review the rest at architectural depth.

  2. Run it as a product. Own the roadmap, the contracts your consumers rely on, the adoption metric, and the deprecation policy that keeps the surface clean.

  3. Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and stand up the eval and review gates that make agent-authored code trustworthy.

  4. Harvest the field. Turn recurring customer patterns into platform capabilities, so learning compounds instead of fragmenting into bespoke forks.

  5. Lead by example. Write the load-bearing code, pair with your engineers, raise their craft, and grow the squad as the leverage you ship earns it.

Your impact

Every Solution squad and every customer deployment is only as strong as the platform underneath it. Own a capability cluster well and you create leverage the entire company compounds on — the difference between a platform that scales and a pile of one-off forks.

What we're looking for

This is a lead-by-example role for a senior engineer who builds platforms other engineers love. You're excited by deep, high-blast-radius problems, you measure yourself by what others build on your work, and you lead by being among the best engineers in the room.

You'll need:

  • A track record of shipping production platform / framework / infrastructure that other engineers build on (SPIs, libraries, runtimes, dev tooling, or AI substrate)

  • Deep, current hands-on coding — we build in Kotlin / Java 25 (TypeScript/React for the experience squads); strong here, or a fast learner

  • Real API / SPI / abstraction-design judgment, with a feel for performance and correctness at scale (up to hundreds of millions of records)

  • A platform-as-product mindset — you optimize for adoption and others' leverage, and you're comfortable deprecating

  • A track record of leading senior engineers by example, not by leaving the keyboard

Nice to have:

  • Running a team as an internal platform (adoption metrics, internal NPS, deprecation, roadmap)

  • Squad-relevant depth — codegen/annotation processors, Kubernetes/IaC/observability, React/design systems, MCP/LSP/agent harnesses, ERP/connectors, or end-user agent UX

  • AI-native ways of working (agentic workflows, eval harnesses, spec-driven development)

  • Aerospace / defense / discrete-manufacturing context

  • French is a plus, not a requirement

If you bring the essentials and a strong mix of the rest, we want to hear from you — we're hiring the person who'll make this real, not a checklist.

What we offer

  • A real ownership mandate over a capability cluster, with equity in a category-defining scale-up

  • Deep, high-leverage problems with real customers and real scale

  • An AI-native engineering culture and a small, elite squad — be challenged, learn, and have fun

As a Sales Operations Intern (m/w/d), you will keep the engine behind our sales teams running cleanly: you own recurring CRM hygiene, accurate user set-up and reliable bonus data so reps can spend their time selling. Supporting the Head of Sales Operations and the GTM Engineer, you will work across a global, multi-market and two-tier sales organisation, partnering with Sales Leads, Customer Service and the Data team to turn messy inputs into decisions people can trust. From your first month you take real ownership of the processes that keep user management, bonus calculations and reporting accurate.

PERGOLUX designs and sells premium, Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from aluminium pergolas to awnings and garden furniture, direct to consumers. We are a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond, with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue and operations across our core markets, and Sales Operations sits at the centre of how that growth is planned, measured and paid.

What You'll Do

- Onboard and offboard sales users across HubSpot, Aircall and our messaging tools (seats, permissions, teams and task queues), keep the set-up aligned to the org chart, and run a monthly seat and licence check.

- Prepare the monthly data for bonus calculations for Sales Leads, Tier 2 reps and the Tier 1 partner, check inputs against source data (orders, attribution, owner changes, returns), and flag exceptions before payout.

- Run recurring CRM hygiene programmes (duplicates, missing or wrong fields, wrong owners, stale deals and tasks, inactive workflows), track data quality per market, and follow up with Sales Leads where logging standards slip.

- Pull and prepare weekly and monthly sales reports from HubSpot, Looker and spreadsheets, and answer ad hoc questions such as conversion by market, speed to lead, task backlog or rep activity.

- Support the GTM Engineer with data checks and analysis for capacity planning and productivity projects, and act as first point of contact when reps are stuck with access or tool issues.

What You'll Bring

- Enrolled or recently graduated with Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, economics, information systems, data or a related field.

- Strong spreadsheet skills (lookups, pivots, clean formulas) and an eye for numbers that do not add up.

- Structured and reliable: you finish recurring tasks on time, every time, and document what you do.

- Fluent English.

- Nice to have: first experience with a CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce) or a BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI), basic SQL, German or another market language, and an interest in sales, operations and AI tools.

💼 Compensation — Competitive salary · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, no endless unpaid crunch

🚀 Growth and Career Development — You get real ownership of recurring processes from the start with direct impact on how a multi-market sales organisation is run, you learn hands-on HubSpot administration, CRM data governance, Looker reporting and how incentive schemes are designed and tested, and you work alongside an international, collaborative team with fast-track opportunities to grow as PERGOLUX scales.

⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27 · One week per year remote workation in the EU/UK

🌟 Benefits and Lifestyle

- Jobrad / Bike leasing programme, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting

- Regular team events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work gatherings) and retreats

- Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows)

- Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products

📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, 10997 Berlin, Building C, 6th floor (hybrid)

How to Apply

Ready to keep our sales engine clean and accurate? Apply through our [Career Page](https://pergolux.careers/) or reach out via [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/pergolux/posts/?feedView=all). This is a 6-month, full-time internship (part-time from 30 hours per week is possible), based in Berlin on a hybrid basis.

PERGOLUX is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, we think it's less about ticking every box and more about what you bring to the table!

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to help build a lean, AI-native accounting function at n8n, owning core accounting operations while using automation and AI to make our processes smarter, faster, and more scalable.

You’ll report to our Head of Accounting & Tax, working alongside an experienced team where you’ll have real ownership from day one and the opportunity to expand into new areas as we grow.

Here's how you'll make an impact:

Own Procure-to-Pay & Expense Operations

  • Manage the end-to-end P2P process in Ramp, from invoice intake and coding to approval follow-ups and biweekly AP payments, ensuring strong controls.

  • Improve AI-assisted coding, automation rules, and exception handling to reduce manual work and keep transactions accurate.

  • Support colleagues with expenses, reimbursements, and corporate card questions, resolving issues efficiently.

Deliver Accurate Accounting & Month-End Close

  • Own assigned OPEX, card spend, accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, journal entries, and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Partner with FP&A to ensure accurate GL and cost-center coding, timely financial information, and a reliable month-end close.

  • Maintain clear accounting records, support audit requests, and document processes to ensure continuity and effective controls.

Build an AI-Native Accounting Function

  • Use n8n, AI tools, and modern accounting platforms to identify opportunities for automation and continuously improve workflows.

  • Validate AI-generated outputs, prioritize human review where risks are highest, and maintain reliable evidence for stakeholders, regulators, and auditors.

  • Help scale accounting processes across our growing multi-entity business, with opportunities to broaden your expertise into AR and revenue accounting over time.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 📚 Hands-on accounting experience: You have practical GL and AP/P2P experience, with solid fundamentals in journal entries, accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, and reconciliations.

  • ⚖️ Accounting standards & VAT: You have working knowledge of HGB or IFRS, understand invoice requirements and VAT fundamentals, and know when to seek expert guidance.

  • 🤖 AI & automation mindset: You're excited to experiment with AI, build better workflows, and learn how to validate automated outputs rather than simply execute transactions.

  • 📊 Systems & spreadsheet skills: You're confident using spreadsheets and accounting systems, with strong attention to coding accuracy, data quality, and financial controls.

  • 🎯 Ownership & reliability: You take responsibility for daily operations, follow through on commitments, and proactively identify ways to improve how things work.

  • 💬 Clear communication: You communicate effectively in English, collaborate well across teams, and enjoy helping colleagues solve operational challenges.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🛠️ Modern finance tools: You've worked with AI-native ERPs, Ramp or similar P2P platforms, Q2C tools, or workflow automation platforms like n8n.

  • 🌍 International accounting: You have experience working across multiple entities, ideally in a global business with an expanding international footprint.

  • 💰 SaaS & revenue accounting: You're familiar with SaaS business models, multi-currency accounting, AR, or revenue recognition.

  • 🔍 Audit & qualifications: You bring an audit background or relevant accounting qualifications that strengthen your accounting expertise.

  • 🇩🇪 German language skills: You can communicate in German, although this is not required for the role.

Why join us?

At n8n, you won't just process transactions — you'll help rethink how accounting works at an automation company. You'll own meaningful parts of our accounting operations, build AI-powered improvements you can see in action, and help shape a scalable finance function at one of Europe's fastest-growing startups.

You'll join a supportive, remote-first team where autonomy, curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning are encouraged. Working closely with experienced colleagues, you'll have the opportunity to deepen your GL, P2P, and close expertise while gradually expanding into AR and revenue accounting as we grow.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of AI-native accounting.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Intern (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Als Revenue Operations Intern (w/m/d) bei LIQID wirst du:

Reports und Dashboards in HubSpot und Omni für Sales, Relationship Management und das Leadership-Team aufbauen und laufend weiterentwickeln. Du bist erste Anlaufstelle für Fragen und Anliegen von HubSpot-Nutzer:innen, dokumentierst Lösungen und Konfigurationen und hilfst dabei, das System verständlich und effizient zu nutzen.

Darüber hinaus übernimmst du Aufgaben im Bereich Datenqualität: Du identifizierst und behebst Duplikate, leerstehende oder ungenutzte Properties sowie fehlerhafte Ansichten direkt an der Ursache. Du unterstützt den oder die RevOps Manager:in bei der HubSpot-Administration – etwa bei Nutzer:innen, Teams und Properties – sowie bei der Bereinigung nach der Salesforce-Migration.

Zudem arbeitest du mit den kommerziellen Teams an kleinen Projekten: Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, entwickelst daraus Lösungen und begleitest sie bis zur Umsetzung, einschließlich einfacher Automatisierungen, die vor dem Go-live geprüft werden.

Die Position ist ab Januar 2027 zu besetzen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Teamübergreifende Einblicke: Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Relationship Management und dem Leadership-Team zusammen und lernst, wie Revenue Operations die operativen Abläufe eines wachsenden Fintechs unterstützt.

  • Datenbasierte Entscheidungen: Du erstellst und pflegst Reports und Dashboards in HubSpot und Omni und hilfst unseren Teams, fundierte Entscheidungen auf Basis verlässlicher Daten zu treffen.

  • Operative Unterstützung: Du unterstützt unsere Teams bei Fragen rund um HubSpot, dokumentierst Lösungen und hilfst dabei, Hindernisse im Arbeitsalltag zu beseitigen.

  • Eigene Projekte: Du begleitest kleinere Projekte von der Anforderungsaufnahme bis zur Umsetzung – von Prozessverbesserungen bis hin zu einfachen Automatisierungen, die vor dem Go-live gemeinsam geprüft werden.

  • Datenqualität und CRM: Du verbesserst die Qualität unserer CRM-Daten und unterstützt bei der HubSpot-Administration sowie bei der Bereinigung nach der Salesforce-Migration.

  • Praxisnahes Lernen: Du erlebst hautnah, wie aus Daten, Prozessen und technischen Lösungen konkrete Verbesserungen entstehen – in einem Unternehmen, das über 4 Milliarden Euro an Vermögen verwaltet.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du hast dein Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren Fach vor Kurzem abgeschlossen.

  • Du hast bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen gesammelt – etwa durch ein Praktikum, eine Werkstudierendentätigkeit, eine studentische Initiative oder ein Ehrenamt. Idealerweise hattest du dabei Berührungspunkte mit Vertrieb, Finanzen oder Datenanalyse.

  • Du gehst sicher mit Excel oder Google Sheets um und hast bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen mit einem CRM-System wie HubSpot oder Salesforce gesammelt.

  • Du denkst strukturiert und analytisch und priorisierst Aufgaben danach, welchen Mehrwert sie für das Unternehmen schaffen.

  • Du kommunizierst klar und verständlich – schriftlich wie mündlich und auch mit Kolleg:innen ohne technischen Hintergrund.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben, bringst sie eigenständig zum Abschluss und dokumentierst deine Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar.

  • Du bist neugierig, möchtest dazulernen und fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist.

  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau, idealerweise C1, sowie Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau.

Damit punktest du zusätzlich

  • Grundkenntnisse in SQL sowie erste Erfahrungen mit einem Business-Intelligence-Tool wie Omni, Looker, Power BI oder Tableau.

  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt.

  • Erste Erfahrungen mit der Erstellung automatisierter Workflows, beispielsweise mit n8n, Zapier oder Make.

  • Erfahrung mit der Einführung von KI-Tools in einem Unternehmen oder einer Organisation.

  • Interesse an Finanzthemen oder Vermögensverwaltung.

  • Zertifizierungen der HubSpot Academy.

Erfüllst du nicht alle Bedingungen ? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Diversität: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich vom ersten Tag an zu einem integralen Teil unseres vielfältigen Teams internationaler Talente.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht komplizierter, sondern einfacher. Mit flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und mobilem Arbeiten findest du die Balance, die zu dir passt. 24 Urlaubstage sowie zwei zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31. Dezember sorgen für ausreichend Erholung.

  • Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements – in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen mit hoher Markt­relevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

  • Ausstattung: MacBook, Kopfhörer und Bildschirm gehören bei uns selbstverständlich dazu.

  • Well-being: Mittagessen budget von bis zu 112,50 € im Monat sowie regionale Bio-Produkte halten dich in unserem Büro am Ku’damm fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen wie Beachvolleyball, die Soccer Startup League oder unser Health Assistance Program sorgen darüber hinaus für dein Wohlbefinden.

So geht es für dich weiter

  1. Erstes virtuelles Kennenlernen mit einem Talent Partner: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob Deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen.

  2. Persönliches Interview mit dem Hiring Manager: Wir tauchen tiefer in die Rolle und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten ein und lösen gemeinsam ein Alltagsproblem für praktische Einblicke in Deine zukünftige Arbeit.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Account Manager - Nordics
jobs.description:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.

Role summary

We're looking for an Senior Enterprise Account Manager to join our expanding team in London focussing on some of the largest accounts across the Nordics region. There are a few things we take really seriously here at monday.com: building an amazing product and providing the best possible service to our customers. Our clients love what we've built and this role puts you at the centre of it, working with some of the world's most recognisable brands as they reimagine how work gets done.

 

As a Senior Enterprise Account Manager, you'll work with a book of global enterprise accounts — household names operating across multiple markets — to deepen their investment in monday.com and expand it. These are organisations at the forefront of enterprise AI transformation, moving fast to rewire their workflows, integrate intelligent agents into how they operate, and get ahead of competitors who aren't moving as quickly. Your job is to be the strategic partner that helps them do exactly that.

This is a quota-carrying role that requires strong executive-level sales skills, relationship-building capabilities, and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences.

 

Please note this is a hybrid role with a 3 day per week in the office requirement.

 

About the role;

  • The Account Manager position is a growth focused quota-carrying position; you will own the full sales cycle from generating opportunities, building strategic relationships with key stakeholders to negotiation, contracting and eventual renewal.

  • Research, identify, and engage opportunities within a territory of Enterprise accounts with existing spend. Proactively prospect into your accounts (cold calls, emails, social selling, networking, etc.) to build a robust pipeline.

  • Use the value framework and MEDDPICC to enact robust deal progression processes in collaboration with management to advance and close opportunities with new, complex use cases.

  • Strategically build relationships within accounts to build qualified champions. Gaining access to C-Level and VP economic buyers to ensure monday.com becomes a strategic partner of our Enterprise customers, aligned to corporate level goals.

  • Possess a comprehensive understanding of monday.com’s solution and connect this knowledge directly to customer ROI at the enterprise level.

  • Work closely with the Customer Success team and other internal stakeholders to create the conditions for account growth. This means setting the strategic direction, aligning internal resources, and ensuring monday.com shows up as one coordinated partner to our most demanding customers.

  • Continuously build and refine in-depth knowledge of the target industry, including trends, challenges, key players, and opportunities, to effectively position our solutions and add value to C-Level client conversations.

Requirements:

  • Experience: 5+ years of sales experience in a closing role at a SaaS or technology-related field, with a focus on larger Enterprise accounts with a global footprint.

  • Proven Success: Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and driving revenue growth with large, complex organizations. Experience of the Nordics region is preferred.

  • Sales Skills: Strong ability to prospect, qualify, and close deals with large, complex businesses. Experience with a consultative, value-based sales approach at the executive level.

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts in a clear and relatable manner to senior stakeholders.

  • Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with technology, with the ability to quickly learn and demonstrate the functionality of software products, particularly in the context of enterprise solutions.

  • Disruptive technology: Experience selling genuinely new, category-defining technology. Comfortable helping customers navigate the shift from legacy ways of working to something meaningfully better.

  • CRM Proficiency: Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot for managing sales activities and pipeline.

  • Internal leadership: Proven ability to lead without direct authority, rallying Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Legal, and Executive sponsors around a shared account strategy. You're the person internal teams look to for direction on the accounts you own.

  • Problem Solver: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify complex business challenges and develop tailored, enterprise-level solutions.

  • Customer-Centric: Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences and adding strategic value to key client relationships.

  • Self-Starter: A proactive attitude with the ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage time effectively.

jobs.title: Onboard Software Engineer - Hyperdrive
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our core products. This is responsible for monitoring and control of major space program elements, including:

  • Flight Products computational environments (including physical and virtual processors);

  • Interfaces with external equipment (imagers, RF, ISL); and

  • Interfaces with the spacecraft bus.

Hyperdrive is the common platform powering every onboard service across our spacecraft.
The team builds the core capabilities other onboard services need to run mission logic—from interactions and housekeeping to events, automated fault detection and recovery, and lifecycle management.
By making complex spacecraft software consistent, observable, and resilient, Hyperdrive helps teams move faster while keeping missions safe in orbit.

We’re hiring for one position across multiple locations - you only need to apply once.

About this role:
  • Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability.
  • Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase.
  • Design and implement unit tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code.
  • Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches.
  • Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review
  • Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards.
  • Coordinate with downstream teams on the release, distribution and adoption of latest releases.
  • In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites.

Must Haves:
  • 5+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with continuous integration tools (e.g., GitLab-CI, Jenkins).
  • Experience with build systems (e.g., Make, CMake).
  • Experience with library management and ABI/API version control.
  • Understanding of distributed architecture.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP, TCP, IP) and POSIX standards.
  • Experience in developing multi-threaded applications.

Nice to Haves:
  • Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust.
  • Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms.
  • Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity)
  • Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ/NATS, etc.)
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S, systemd-nspawn)

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    •  *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

  • Support the CEO and Head of the CEO Office on critical cross-functional initiatives by helping coordinate day-to-day delivery, stakeholder collaboration and progress towards measurable outcomes.

  • Help investigate complex, ambiguous problems by clarifying the problem, developing practical solutions and supporting the implementation of durable processes or systems.

  • Assist leadership in navigating ambiguity by surfacing insights, decisions and risks, coordinating follow-through and supporting alignment across teams, particularly where there is no natural owner.

  • Projects may include organisational model design, international expansion strategy, scaling new business lines, strategic planning and goal setting, go-to-market execution, regulatory, data and financial infrastructure initiatives, and supporting board and shareholder reporting.

What We're Looking For (Background and core competencies)

Payments or fintech exposure and international experience are advantages.

  • Learning agility and entrepreneurial mindset: Learn quickly, respond well to feedback, adapt to changing priorities and show evidence of creating, launching or materially improving something from scratch. Founding or entrepreneurial experience is valued but not required.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

Rescale is pioneering the future of engineering and scientific discovery. As the leader in digital engineering, we help the world’s most advanced organizations develop better products faster through intelligent automation, applied AI, data management, and access to the world’s largest network of engineering and R&D applications.

Rescale brings together elastic, enterprise-grade HPC with advanced modeling and simulation, agentic engineering, AI Physics, and the software and data workflows that connect them. Our customers use Rescale to modernize R&D, accelerate simulation, automate engineering processes, and turn engineering data into faster, better decisions across industries including automotive, manufacturing, aerospace, energy, life sciences, and semiconductors.

Joining Rescale means becoming part of a diverse, collaborative, and mission-driven team solving complex challenges that traditional HPC alone cannot address.

The Role

We are looking for a high-performing Strategic Account Executive to lead direct enterprise sales and account growth across France.

This is an entrepreneurial, field-based role focused on building and expanding strategic relationships with key and enterprise accounts. You will own a defined portfolio of named accounts, create demand, develop executive relationships, win new business, and expand Rescale’s footprint from foundational HPC into advanced modeling and simulation, agentic engineering, and AI Physics.

You will operate as the commercial owner of your territory: setting the account strategy, identifying business problems, building internal champions, creating compelling value cases, and leading complex sales cycles from first engagement through renewal and expansion. This is a direct-sales role, not a channel-led position. You will work closely with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Sales Development, Product, and Rescale leadership, while retaining ownership of the commercial strategy and outcome.

France is a priority market, with particular emphasis on automotive and manufacturing enterprises where engineering organizations are investing in digital engineering transformation. Success requires the ability to sell both into existing strategic relationships and into new enterprise accounts where Rescale can create meaningful business impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and grow a focused portfolio of strategic key and enterprise accounts across France.

  • Build account and territory plans that identify the highest-value expansion paths, whitespace, executive relationships, and competitive risks.

  • Expand existing Rescale customers by introducing additional capabilities across the platform, from Rescale HPC to Advanced Modeling and Simulation, Agentic Engineering, and AI Physics.

  • Generate pipeline through proactive prospecting, account-based engagement, executive networking, customer insight, and disciplined market development.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que Concepteur(trice) de Systèmes Etirables Autonomes, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en formation, recherche et innovation affecté au département électronique flexible. Au sein de ce département vous conjuguez passion scientifique et goût pour l’innovation.

Au sein du Centre Microélectronique de Provence, le département FEL mène ses recherches dans le domaine de l'électronique flexible et étirable, pour des applications dédiées aux objets "wearable" et au « monitoring » environnemental. La conception de systèmes complets, du capteur au module de de communication, en fonction des contraintes énergétiques et environnementales est un élément essentiel permettant la réalisation de prototypes compatibles avec les cas d'usages étudiés.

Vous aurez pour mission principale, à partir du savoir-faire du département de développer l'expertise électronique dans le domaine des objets autonomes / autoalimentés pour le monitoring environnemental (Projet Hydrademo) et des interfaces "wearable" pour la perception augmentée( Projet flexeo3D). ·           Vous participez à la réalisation de prototypes innovants et à leur test en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes de recherche

·      Junior accepté : oui si expérience pertinente lors des stages

 

En outre, vous possédez :

•      Une expérience dans le développement de systèmes à microcontrôleurs

•      Une expérience pratique de la conception et de la réalisation des cartes électroniques

•      De bonnes connaissances en électronique analogique

•      La connaissance de procédés d’intégration électronique sur support flexible serait un plus

•           Votre capacité à évoluer dans un environnement collaboratif de recherche et développement

•           Votre autonomie et votre sens de l’initiative

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

·           Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

·           Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

·           Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform takes care of the business behind the trip: proposals, bookings, payments and customer management. That lets organizers focus on what they do best: designing and leading unforgettable experiences.

What's the role

As organizers grow, WeTravel stops being a standalone tool and becomes part of their stack. A tour operator wants bookings to flow into their own tools, payments to land in their accounting system, and leads to sync with their CRM. Getting that right is often what wins the deal, and what keeps the customer for years.

In practice, you're the technical partner organizers and our commercial team rely on, from the first discovery call to a smooth go-live. You'll understand how a travel business runs, design how WeTravel fits into it, and prove it works using our public APIs, webhooks and no-code tools like Zapier.

But the role goes beyond individual customers. As more organizers connect WeTravel to their business, every integration teaches us something about what the platform should do next. We want Solution Engineering to be the voice of our customers' integration needs inside engineering, and a stakeholder for WeTravel's public interfaces. You'll spot the patterns across deals, decide what should become a platform capability instead of a one-off, and work with product engineering teams to make it happen. You will bridge low-level communication paths and high-level vehicle interfaces, developing reusable platform capabilities while supporting brand-specific configurations.

This role combines software development, systems integration, troubleshooting, and developer enablement. You will help turn vehicle signals and hardware capabilities into dependable services, libraries, gateway behaviors, and APIs that partner engineers can discover, integrate, test, and use successfully. The role is well suited to a developer who enjoys working across system boundaries and taking software from design through production support.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite.

  • Decide whether functionality belongs in a reusable platform abstraction, gateway mapping, vehicle service, application, or vehicle- or brand-specific integration; deploy and validate services across vehicle-oriented compute platforms, virtualized embedded environments, simulators, software-in-the-loop systems, benches, and prototype vehicles.

Digitale Identitäten, sichere Kommunikation und der Schutz sensibler Daten sind zentrale Voraussetzungen einer modernen digitalen Gesellschaft. Für den IT-Bereich suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior Solution Architect – Public Trust PKI (TLS & S/MIME) (m/w/d), der die strategische und technische Weiterentwicklung der IT-Systemlandschaft sowie der Public-Trust-PKI maßgeblich mitgestaltet.

In dieser Position übernimmst Du eine zentrale Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Architektur, Entwicklung, PKI-Betrieb und weiteren Fachbereichen. Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit fundierter technischer Expertise und schaffen die Voraussetzungen für leistungsfähige, sichere und zukunftsfähige Systemarchitekturen.

Aufgaben

  • Technologie- und Applikationsstrategie: Du koordinierst bereichsübergreifend die Weiterentwicklung einer ganzheitlichen Applikations- und Technologiestrategie für die Systemlandschaft sowie die Komponenten, Produkte und Lösungen unseres Mandanten.
