jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll help Airwallex manage and improve the economics of card payments, with a focus on scheme fees and interchange across Visa and Mastercard. You’ll turn complex network rules and payment data into accurate configurations, actionable analysis and decisions that improve cost visibility and margin performance.

  • Own payment-cost analysis across scheme fees, interchange and network rules, identifying changes and translating them into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

  • Maintain accurate fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic with Product and Engineering, ensuring payment-cost calculations and customer billing reflect current network rules.

  • Build models and reporting across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types to identify margin drivers, anomalies, leakage and opportunities to improve payment economics.

  • Support cost and margin optimisation through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration and related levers, contributing to pricing, product design, market launches and commercial decisions.

  • Strengthen governance, testing, reconciliation and controls by comparing expected costs with actual network charges and helping drive root-cause resolution.

  • Partner with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, Operations and external payment partners to resolve scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions.

You’ll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or a related role, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.

  • Strong knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules.

  • Experience translating complex payment rules, fee schedules or network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls.

  • Experience working with payment-cost systems or controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modelling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs.

  • Commercial judgment and the ability to connect payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimisation.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale.

  • Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners.

Preferred

  • Experience partnering directly with Visa, Mastercard or other payment networks.

  • Experience applying AI or advanced analytics to rule interpretation, anomaly detection or payment-cost optimisation.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

Learn more about your team

Finance & Corporate Development helps Airwallex grow with control. We’re a trusted partner to the business, providing actionable insights on performance, supporting market and product expansion and helping to shape the future of our product. We ensure that Airwallex meets its financial reporting, tax and safeguarding obligations globally. We work with existing and prospective investors to raise capital and ensure it is deployed effectively.

This is a team for people who want to reimagine how the CFO office works. We’re looking for founder-like energy, high integrity and a passion for technology. You’ll thrive here if you enjoy working cross-functionally, think from first principles and can balance speed of execution with analytical precision.

jobs.title: Senior Partnership Manager Payments
jobs.description:
Opleiding: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in bedrijfskunde, economie, finance, commerciële economie of vergelijkbaar.
Ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships of business development.
Kennis: Van card schemes, issuing, acquiring en de werking van het internationale betalingsverkeer.
Persoonlijkheid: Je bent communicatief sterk, organisatiesensitief, zelfstandig en overtuigend op senior niveau.
Salaris: € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

Elke dag checken 6,5 miljoen Nederlanders in om te reizen met het OV. Met de OV-chipkaart, OV-pas, betaalpas, creditcard of mobiel. En dat werkt simpel en soepel. Kaart voor de lezer en … ‘bliep’. Reizen maar! Maar achter die ‘bliep’ gaat een complexe wereld schuil. Welkom in de wereld van Translink!

Met de introductie van nieuwe betaalmogelijkheden onder de vlag OVpay is Translink dichter komen te staan bij de bredere financiële sector. In- en uitchecken met de bankpas vereist goede afstemming met banken. Maar ook de bredere inzet van EMV-technologie met OVpay maakt dat we als bedrijf te maken hebben met bestaande card schemes.

Als Senior Partnership Manager Payments - Card Schemes & Banken, ben jij het externe gezicht van Translink binnen het paymentecosysteem. Je onderhoudt strategische relaties met onder andere Visa, Mastercard, banken en andere belangrijke partijen in het betalingsverkeer. Je begrijpt hun belangen en ontwikkelingen en weet deze te verbinden met de ambities van Translink en OVpay.

Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op senior niveau en voert gesprekken met zowel inhoudelijke experts als directies en bestuurders. Daarbij begrijp je niet alleen de commerciële kant van partnerships, maar ook hoe de paymentketen inhoudelijk werkt. Je weet wat ontwikkelingen binnen issuing, acquiring en card schemes betekenen voor Translink en kunt deze vertalen naar concrete keuzes en afspraken.

Intern werk je nauw samen met onder andere Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations en IT. Daarnaast vorm je samen met collega’s die zich meer richten op ontwikkeling en data een sterk team: jij richt je primair op de externe relaties en strategische partnerships.

Waar ga je dagelijks mee aan de slag:

  • Je bouwt en onderhoudt strategische relaties met Visa, Mastercard, Nederlandse banken, issuers en andere relevante partijen binnen payments.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor externe stakeholders en vertegenwoordigt Translink in strategische en inhoudelijke gesprekken.

  • Je ontwikkelt een duidelijke partnershipstrategie en meerjarige agenda voor de samenwerking met card schemes en banken.

  • Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer, scheme rules en marktstandaarden en vertaalt deze naar impact en concrete acties voor Translink.

  • Je voert inhoudelijke en commerciële onderhandelingen over voorwaarden, kosten, dienstverlening en gezamenlijke verbeterinitiatieven.

  • Je verbindt externe marktontwikkelingen met interne technische, financiële en datagedreven inzichten.

  • Je adviseert management en directie over kansen, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en ontwikkelingen binnen het paymentecosysteem.

  • Je zorgt voor afstemming tussen Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, IT en externe partners bij complexe trajecten rondom payments en scheme compliance.

  • Je draagt bij aan de verdere professionalisering en mogelijke organisatorische ontwikkeling van de paymentactiviteiten binnen Translink.


WIE ZOEKEN WE?

We zoeken een ervaren paymentprofessional die zijn of haar sporen in de sector heeft verdiend. Je begrijpt hoe banken, issuers, acquirers en card schemes met elkaar samenwerken en weet wat er nodig is om binnen dat complexe speelveld duurzame partnerships op te bouwen.

Je voelt je comfortabel aan tafel met senior stakeholders en bestuurders. Je kunt complexe onderwerpen helder uitleggen en weet de vertaalslag te maken tussen de buitenwereld en de interne organisatie. Tegelijkertijd ben je pragmatisch. Je bouwt niet alleen relaties, maar zorgt ook dat afspraken daadwerkelijk leiden tot resultaat.

Voor een ervaren professional biedt deze rol bovendien iets bijzonders: je werkt aan een maatschappelijk relevant betalingssysteem dat dagelijks door miljoenen reizigers wordt gebruikt.

WAT ZIT ERIN JOUW TAS?

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships, business development of relatiemanagement.

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met partijen zoals card schemes, banken, issuers, acquirers, paymentnetwerken of andere organisaties binnen het betalingsverkeer.

  • Je hebt kennis van onderwerpen zoals scheme rules, scheme economics, fees, incentives en ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer.

  • Je bent gewend om complexe relaties en onderhandelingen op senior niveau te voeren.

  • Je kunt marktontwikkelingen, financiële belangen en inhoudelijke vraagstukken vertalen naar heldere voorstellen en concrete resultaten.

  • Je communiceert overtuigend met zowel inhoudelijke experts als senior management en externe bestuurders.

  • Je bent organisatiesensitief, analytisch en zelfstandig en weet mensen mee te krijgen zonder formele hiërarchie.

  • Je beheerst zowel het Nederlands als het Engels uitstekend.

WAT BIEDT TRANSLINK JOU?

Translink is een leuke, uitdagende werkplek. We werken in een dynamische, veelzijdige omgeving met een hoog ontwikkeltempo. Samenwerken, Wendbaarheid en Zelfregie zijn onze kernwaarden en dat proef je op de werkvloer.

Translink biedt een prettige kantooromgeving met fijne werkplekken. Onze werksfeer is informeel, open en behulpzaam. Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn aantrekkelijk. Vrij bewegen is ons motto. Je kunt in goed overleg hybride werken en we bieden bewegingsruimte om balans aan te brengen tussen je werk- en privéleven. Zo kun je met onze thuiswerkregeling ook thuis een fijne werkplek inrichten.

Voor je eigen ontwikkeling bieden wij de GoodHabitz online leeromgeving aan. Zo kun je jezelf continu blijven ontwikkelen. We hebben bij Translink ook de mogelijkheid om een (elektrische) fiets te leasen, dit kan zowel voor privé als woon-werkverkeer.

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m. Dit is afhankelijk van je ervaring en kwalificaties, op basis van een 40-urige werkweek. Daar bovenop ontvang je een keuzebudget van 6,94% van je salaris, dit is gemiddeld € 500,- p/m. Daarnaast krijg je 8% vakantiegeld, reiskosten en een goede pensioenregeling. Deze functie is voor minimaal 32 uur per week.

IS DEZE VACATURE OP JOUW LIJF GESCHREVEN?

jobs.title: Senior Manager Account Management
jobs.description:
About the Role

Account Management is where DataSnipper grows. Our EMEA Accounting AM team manages a book worth tens of millions in ARR across the region's leading audit and accounting firms, and we believe that book can double. The growth won't come from renewals that run themselves. It will come from moving customers onto our AI and Agents platform, defending against cheaper point solutions and free AI tools, and handling firms that keep acquiring each other.

As Senior Manager, Account Management – EMEA, you'll lead a team of 5 Account Managers, report to our EMEA Sales leader, and own retention, expansion and forecast accuracy for the region. This is a player-coach role in spirit. You'll be in the deals and in front of senior partners and executives, not managing from a dashboard.

Why DataSnipper

The best commercial opportunities don't come around every day. Selling technology that's transforming an entire industry is one of them.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer in our Amsterdam office to build Alwin, our Agentic Automation Platform for audit and finance, and the systems around it. Alwin agents run multi-step audit procedures over client evidence and return finished workpapers with every number traced back to source. Humans plan, review and sign off.

This is a hands-on role: most of your time will be spent writing code, building the hardest parts of the runtime, prototyping new capabilities and getting them into production. You lead by example: engineers follow your direction because they see it work in your code. Your impact will also come through the engineers and teams you work with.

Your mission is to build the best agentic runtime for audit: one that completes audit tasks faster, more accurately, more reliably and at lower cost, while scaling to meet the needs of our largest customers.

You will identify the problems that most constrain that mission, align teams around a technical direction and drive solutions through to measurable results, while building the foundations other engineers use and raising the quality of Alwin’s agents in production.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

jobs.title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $100k-$200k/yr (including equity)
jobs.description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

  • 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

  • a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

jobs.title: Supply Chain Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Achieving this ambitious goal requires more than innovative engineering — it requires a supply chain capable of turning complex technologies into reliable, manufacturable solutions.

As a Supply Chain Engineer, you'll serve as the critical technical link between our Engineering teams and external suppliers, ensuring components, materials, and systems can be sourced, manufactured, and delivered to meet our development needs. You'll own technical sourcing assessments and supplier readiness across one or two assigned technology domains, such as Laser, Targetry, Chamber, or Core Engineering.

Working closely with Engineering, Strategic Procurement, and Quality Management, you'll bring supplier capabilities and manufacturing expertise into the development process early, identifying technical challenges, assessing manufacturability, and addressing supply risks before they become costly delays. This is an opportunity to apply your engineering expertise in a highly collaborative, fast-moving environment where your technical judgment directly influences project readiness and our ability to scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own Technical Sourcing Readiness: Lead technical feasibility and sourcing-readiness assessments across your assigned technology domain, evaluating supplier capabilities, manufacturing processes, and technical requirements from early development through sourcing readiness.

  • Connect Engineering with Suppliers: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for suppliers within your domain, partnering with Engineering and Strategic Procurement to identify, assess, and engage potential suppliers.

  • Drive Early Supplier Involvement: Bring supplier manufacturing expertise into the development process early, identifying manufacturability challenges and opportunities before designs are finalized.

  • Translate Engineering Requirements: Work with Engineering to clarify incomplete or ambiguous specifications, drawings, and technical requirements to ensure they are accurate and ready for sourcing.

  • Develop Supplier Readiness: Build and track technical supplier development and qualification plans in partnership with Supplier Quality, ensuring suppliers have the capabilities and readiness needed to support development milestones.

  • Improve Manufacturability and Cost: Collaborate with Engineering and suppliers to identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, reduce complexity, optimize costs, and minimize lead times.

  • Inform Supplier Selection: Provide technical assessments, supplier capability insights, and recommendations to support Strategic Procurement's supplier evaluation and award decisions.

  • Manage Technical Supply Risks: Identify and proactively escalate supplier capacity constraints, long lead times, technical dependencies, and other risks that could impact project timelines.

  • Enable Cross-Functional Alignment: Maintain clear technical documentation, supplier readiness information, and risk assessments to support effective handovers between Engineering, Procurement, and Quality.

Who You Are

  • You have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You bring experience in engineering, technical sourcing, supplier development, manufacturing engineering, or a related role within a complex technical or industrial environment.

  • You have a strong understanding of relevant manufacturing technologies, materials, processes, and supplier capabilities within your area of expertise.

  • You can evaluate technical specifications, engineering drawings, and manufacturing requirements, identifying gaps, ambiguities, and potential manufacturability challenges.

  • You have experience assessing supplier technical capabilities, manufacturing capacity, and readiness, ideally within highly engineered products, advanced manufacturing, or complex system development.

  • You understand how to balance technical requirements, manufacturability, cost, and lead-time considerations to support effective sourcing decisions.

  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and exercising independent technical judgment, knowing when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate decisions requiring Engineering, Quality, or commercial approval.

  • You are a proactive communicator who can translate complex technical findings into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You thrive in cross-functional environments, building trusted relationships with engineers, suppliers, procurement professionals, and quality teams.

  • You demonstrate strong ownership and follow-through, taking responsibility for technical sourcing readiness within your domain and ensuring risks and open issues are addressed early.

  • You enjoy working in a growing organization where you can help establish processes, strengthen supplier relationships, and contribute to building a scalable supply chain.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

jobs.title: Senior CRM Executive - Lifecycle
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

This position will be part of the central CRM & Ops team, composed of 18+ specialists, dedicated to driving and executing global strategic initiatives to grow and retain our New Customer base. Collectively, the team is targeted on growing orders, expanding our subscriber base, improving engagement metrics to retain Deliveroo customers. Serving as the voice of the customer, the CRM & Ops team does this by enhancing personalised user experiences, activating best-in-class campaigns, and putting relevancy at the heart of everything. 

The Role

As a Marketing Manager within the Lifecycle CRM & Ops team you are the voice of Deliveroo when speaking with our customers across the globe. You'll operate under a hybrid work model, spending a minimum of three days a week at our London HQ.

Reporting into the Senior Marketing Manager on the New Customer squad, and working closely with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Global CRM, Marketing Promotions, and Data Science, You'll be a technical, commercially minded CRM marketer who is hands-on in the tooling: building Lifecycle journeys, setting up experiments and audiences, and configuring promotions and in-app merchandising. You'll have end-to-end ownership of the New Customer Lifecycle, from journey design and build through to measurement and ROI. You'll also use personalisation and AI to make journeys more relevant. Your primary focus will be on creating customer-centric journeys that are highly relevant, using the right channels at the right time to deliver meaningful business impact, while working with local markets as you scale your initiatives internationally. 

What you'll be doing

  • Collaborate with multiple stakeholders to support growing the new customer base by combining data-driven insights with CRM best practice to initiate and deliver programs internationally 
  • Build and configure multi-channel journeys (email, push, in-app), including audience logic, triggers, testing and QA
  • Design and build multi-variant Lifecycle experiments
  • Create promotions for new customer acquisition and retention, ensuring accurate setup, targeting and tracking
  • Manage in-app merchandising placements, working with Product and Marketing Promotions
  • Deliver personalisation at scale, and test where AI can improve content and efficiency
  • Own operational delivery, optimisation, reporting of campaigns and weekly trading
  • Proactively monitor and report on campaigns to stakeholders & propose/manage changes and optimisations where necessary
  • Collaborate with the New Customer Lifecycle Manager and Marketing Promotions teams to develop the global CRM new customers lifecycle strategy
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on key projects to create and implement test strategies that optimises performance of new & existing campaigns
  • Be comfortable with data targeting, segmentation & analysis - pulling it, manipulating it and interpreting it, whilst using marketing technology to help achieve customer touchpoints faster and more efficiently than ever before
  • Drive innovative ideas and solutions in response to business and customer needs
  • Provide regular communication with stakeholders, such as the central marketing team, product and engineering teams and local markets, to ensure workloads & deadlines are managed efficiently (we love Slack channels for everything)
  • Conduct post campaign reporting, pulling out the most interesting lessons and using these to guide your future ideas

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree (Marketing or Business preferred) or strong relevant experience
  • A minimum of 3+ years CRM experience
  • Can work in a fast-paced environment and prioritise workload
  • Attention to detail and campaign deadlines are adhered to, maintaining high standards of accuracy
  • Highly computer literate with:
    • HTML familiarity (ability to understand where changes need to be made)
    • Liquid logic 
  • Technical knowledge in CRM automation development
  • Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders groups
  • Data visualisation tools & reporting experience (Looker preferred)
  • CRM deployment experience (Braze or similar is a plus!)

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information..

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Learning & Adoption Specialist (CDD de 12 mois)

Rattachement : Operating Model Design Lead

À noter : Ce poste nécessite un droit au travail déjà acquis dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions la question poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour les opportunités à venir. Merci de postuler en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est l’Energy Intelligence Platform : nous transformons la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les équipements, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Faire le lien entre notre technologie et celles et ceux qui l’utilisent : accompagner nos clients, partenaires et collègues, principalement sur le marché français et plus largement dans les marchés francophones, pour qu’ils comprennent la plateforme Kaluza et surtout la maîtrisent.

  • Être un partenaire de confiance : mener des analyses approfondies des besoins de formation pour comprendre les défis propres à chaque client, partenaire et équipe interne.

  • Concevoir des programmes d’apprentissage sur mesure qui vont au-delà de la formation et produisent des résultats business mesurables.

  • Créer des supports de formation de grande qualité, en français et en anglais : ateliers interactifs, modules d’e-learning et guides de référence rapide.

  • Animer ces sessions à distance et en présentiel, en rendant le complexe simple et en renforçant la confiance de votre audience à chaque échange.

  • Accélérer l’adoption de la plateforme Kaluza grâce à un accompagnement et à du coaching après la formation.

  • Suivre l’efficacité de vos programmes et les améliorer en continu à partir des retours et des indicateurs de performance, pour que la formation ait un impact concret pour nos utilisateurs et pour le secteur de l’énergie.


Ce que vous apportez

Critères essentiels :

  • Bilinguisme : vous êtes à l’aise en français comme en anglais, avec d’excellentes qualités de communication écrite et orale.

  • Expertise en formation SaaS : vous avez une expérience avérée de conception et d’animation de programmes de formation à fort impact dans un environnement SaaS ou technologique.

  • Sens de la simplification : vous savez naturellement traduire des concepts techniques et métier complexes en supports clairs, engageants et pratiques.

  • Talent d’animation : vous êtes un·e intervenant·e dynamique et sûr·e de vous, capable de captiver des publics variés et de créer un cadre d’apprentissage interactif et convivial.

  • Esprit collaboratif et proactif : vous travaillez bien en équipe, vous construisez des relations solides et vous identifiez spontanément des façons d’aider les autres et de progresser en continu.

Idéalement, vous avez :

  • Une connaissance du secteur de l’énergie : une expérience concrète des opérations d’un fournisseur d’énergie ou des technologies de décarbonation, pour relier la formation aux défis réels de nos clients.

  • Une culture de l’excellence opérationnelle : une connaissance des processus de centre de contact ou des technologies de service client, pour concevoir des formations qui améliorent l’efficacité opérationnelle.

  • Une expérience de leadership en formation : un parcours démontré de montée en charge de programmes de formation et une capacité à réfléchir stratégiquement à la construction d’une culture d’apprentissage au sein d’une organisation internationale.

Nos valeurs

Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza :

  • Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets.

  • Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

  • Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

  • Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

Nos avantages

Rémunération & protection : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle Alan, prévoyance (assurance vie et décès x3) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport domicile-travail, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + jours fériés + jours de RTT, congés « Moments That Matter », congé pour événement familial, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, flexibilité dans l’organisation du travail et éligibilité à un congé sabbatique (Career Break)

Venez comme vous êtes

Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur la base du mérite et du potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis de vous lire.

Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre page carrières et sur LinkedIn. Notre politique de protection des données des candidats est disponible ici.
